verses.kjv: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.modern: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

verses.kjv: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.modern: The earth was formless and empty, and darkness covered the face of the deep. The Spirit of God was moving over the surface of the waters.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.modern: God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light.

verses.kjv: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.modern: God saw that the light was good. He separated the light from the darkness.

verses.kjv: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
verses.modern: God called the light 'Day,' and the darkness He called 'Night.' And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
verses.modern: God said, 'Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters to separate the waters from the waters.'

verses.kjv: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
verses.modern: So God made the firmament and separated the waters under the firmament from the waters above it. And it was so.

verses.kjv: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
verses.modern: God called the firmament 'Heaven.' And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
verses.modern: God said, 'Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together into one place, and let the dry ground appear.' And it was so.

verses.kjv: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
verses.modern: God called the dry ground 'Earth,' and the gathered waters He called 'Seas.' And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.modern: God said, 'Let the earth produce vegetation: seed-bearing plants and fruit trees on the earth that bear fruit with seed in it, according to their kinds.' And it was so.

verses.kjv: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.modern: The earth produced vegetation: seed-bearing plants according to their kinds, and trees bearing fruit with seed in it according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
verses.modern: There was evening, and there was morning—the third day.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
verses.modern: God said, 'Let there be lights in the firmament of the heavens to separate the day from the night, and let them serve as signs to mark sacred times, and days and years,

verses.kjv: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
verses.modern: let them be lights in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth.' And it was so.

verses.kjv: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
verses.modern: God made two great lights—the greater light to govern the day and the lesser light to govern the night. He also made the stars.

verses.kjv: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
verses.modern: God set them in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth,

verses.kjv: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
verses.modern: to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
verses.modern: There was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
verses.modern: God said, 'Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the firmament of the heavens.'

verses.kjv: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.modern: So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters teemed, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
verses.modern: God blessed them and said, 'Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth.'

verses.kjv: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
verses.modern: There was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
verses.modern: God said, 'Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, creeping things, and wild animals of the earth according to their kinds.' And it was so.

verses.kjv: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
verses.modern: God made the wild animals according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and every creeping thing of the ground according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

verses.kjv: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.modern: Then God said, 'Let us make man in our image, according to our likeness. Let them rule over the fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the livestock, all the earth, and every creeping thing that moves on the earth.'

verses.kjv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
verses.modern: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created Him; male and female He created them.

verses.kjv: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
verses.modern: God blessed them and said to them, 'Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish of the sea, the birds of the air, and every living thing that moves on the earth.'

verses.kjv: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
verses.modern: Then God said, 'Look, I have given You every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree that has fruit with seed in it. They shall be food for You.

verses.kjv: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
verses.modern: to every wild animal of the earth, every bird of the air, and every creature that moves on the earth—everything that has the breath of life—I have given every green plant for food.' And it was so.

verses.kjv: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
verses.modern: God saw everything He had made. It was very good indeed. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.

chapters.summary: God created the heavens and the earth in six days — light, sky, land and vegetation, sun and moon and stars, sea creatures and birds, and land animals and man. He made man in his own image, male and female, and gave them dominion over every living thing.

verses.kjv: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
verses.modern: So the heavens and the earth were completed, with all their vast array.

verses.kjv: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
verses.modern: On the seventh day God finished the work He had been doing. He rested on the seventh day from all His work.

verses.kjv: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
verses.modern: God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it He rested from all the work of creation that He had done.

verses.kjv: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
verses.modern: These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created, on the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

verses.kjv: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
verses.modern: No shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth, and no plant of the field had yet sprung up, because the LORD God had not sent rain on the earth, and there was no man to work the ground.

verses.kjv: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.modern: But a mist went up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
verses.modern: Then the LORD God formed the man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living soul.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.modern: The LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, and there He placed the man he had formed.

verses.kjv: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
verses.modern: The LORD God made every tree grow out of the ground—trees that were pleasing to the eye and good for food. In the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

verses.kjv: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
verses.modern: A river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it divided and became four headwaters.

verses.kjv: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
verses.modern: The name of the first is Pison; it winds through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.

verses.kjv: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
verses.modern: The gold of that land is good; bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

verses.kjv: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
verses.modern: The name of the second river is Gihon; it winds through the whole land of Ethiopia.

verses.kjv: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
verses.modern: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it runs along the east side of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
verses.modern: The LORD God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
verses.modern: The LORD God commanded the man, 'You are free to eat from any tree in the garden,

verses.kjv: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
verses.modern: but You must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for on the day You eat from it You will surely die.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
verses.modern: Then the LORD God said, 'It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for Him.'

verses.kjv: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
verses.modern: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air. He brought them to Adam to see what he would name them. And whatever Adam called each living creature, that was its name.

verses.kjv: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
verses.modern: So Adam gave names to all the livestock, the birds of the air, and every wild animal. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
verses.modern: So the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall on Adam, and while he slept he took one of his ribs and closed up the flesh in its place.

verses.kjv: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
verses.modern: Then the LORD God made a woman from the rib he had taken from the man. He brought her to the man.

verses.kjv: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
verses.modern: Adam said, 'This at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.'

verses.kjv: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
verses.modern: For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife. They shall become one flesh.

verses.kjv: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
verses.modern: The man and his wife were both naked. They felt no shame.

chapters.summary: God rested on the seventh day and made it holy. He formed Adam from the dust, placed him in the garden of Eden, and commanded him not to eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. God made a woman from Adam's rib and brought her to him as a helper.

verses.kjv: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
verses.modern: Now the serpent was more crafty than any of the wild animals the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, 'Did God really say, You shall not eat from any tree in the garden?'

verses.kjv: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
verses.modern: The woman said to the serpent, 'We may eat the fruit of the trees in the garden,

verses.kjv: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
verses.modern: but God has said, You shall not eat the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, and you shall not touch it, or you will die.'

verses.kjv: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
verses.modern: the serpent said to the woman, 'You will not surely die.

verses.kjv: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
verses.modern: For God knows that on the day you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like gods, knowing good and evil.'

verses.kjv: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
verses.modern: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasing to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her. He ate it.

verses.kjv: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
verses.modern: Then the eyes of both of them were opened. They realized they were naked. So they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.

verses.kjv: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
verses.modern: Then they heard the sound of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and Adam and his wife hid from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
verses.modern: But the LORD God called to Adam and said to him, 'Where are you?'

verses.kjv: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
verses.modern: He answered, 'I heard Your voice in the garden. I was afraid because I was naked, so I hid myself.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
verses.modern: God said, 'Who told You that You were naked? Have You eaten from the tree that I commanded You not to eat from?'

verses.kjv: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
verses.modern: The man said, 'The woman you gave to be with me—she gave me some of the fruit from the tree. I ate it.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
verses.modern: Then the LORD God said to the woman, 'What is this you have done?' The woman said, 'The serpent deceived me. I ate.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
verses.modern: So the LORD God said to the serpent, 'Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock and above every wild animal. On Your belly You shall go, and dust You shall eat all the days of Your life.

verses.kjv: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verses.modern: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your seed and hers; he shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.'

verses.kjv: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
verses.modern: To the woman he said, 'I will greatly multiply your pain in childbearing; in pain you shall bring forth children. Your desire shall be for your husband. He shall rule over you.'

verses.kjv: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
verses.modern: to Adam he said, 'Because you listened to the voice of your wife and ate from the tree about which I commanded you, saying, You shall not eat from it—cursed is the ground because of you; in toil you shall eat from it all the days of your life.

verses.kjv: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
verses.modern: It shall produce thorns and thistles for you, and you shall eat the plants of the field.

verses.kjv: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
verses.modern: By the sweat of your face you shall eat bread, until you return to the ground, because from it you were taken. For dust you are, and to dust you shall return.'

verses.kjv: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
verses.modern: Adam named his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all the living.

verses.kjv: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
verses.modern: The LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and clothed them.

verses.kjv: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
verses.modern: Then the LORD God said, 'Look, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, He must not be allowed to reach out His hand and take also from the tree of life and eat, and live forever.'

verses.kjv: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.modern: So the LORD God sent Him out of the garden of Eden to work the ground from which He had been taken.

verses.kjv: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
verses.modern: He drove the man out, and on the east side of the garden of Eden he placed cherubim and a flaming sword flashing back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.

chapters.summary: The serpent deceived Eve into eating from the forbidden tree, and she gave the fruit to Adam, who also ate. God cursed the serpent, pronounced pain in childbearing for the woman and toil for the man, and drove them out of Eden, placing cherubim to guard the way to the tree of life.

verses.kjv: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.
verses.modern: Adam was intimate with his wife Eve. She conceived and gave birth to Cain. She said, 'I have gotten a man from the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.modern: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the soil.

verses.kjv: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.
verses.modern: In the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
verses.modern: Abel also brought an offering—the firstborn of his flock and their fat. The LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering,

verses.kjv: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
verses.modern: But on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. So Cain was very angry. His face fell.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to Cain, 'Why are you angry, and why has your face fallen?

verses.kjv: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
verses.modern: If You do well, will You not be accepted? But if You do not do well, sin is crouching at the door; its desire is for You, but You must rule over it.'

verses.kjv: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
verses.modern: Cain spoke to his brother Abel, and while they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to Cain, 'Where is your brother Abel?' He said, 'I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?'

verses.kjv: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
verses.modern: The LORD said, 'What have You done? The voice of Your brother's blood cries out to me from the ground.

verses.kjv: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
verses.modern: Now You are cursed from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive Your brother's blood from Your hand.

verses.kjv: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
verses.modern: When You work the ground, it shall no longer yield its strength to You. You shall be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.'

verses.kjv: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.modern: Cain said to the LORD, 'My punishment is greater than I can bear.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
verses.modern: You have driven me out today from the face of the ground. I shall be hidden from Your face. I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
verses.modern: The LORD said to Him, 'Therefore whoever kills Cain, he shall suffer vengeance sevenfold.' And the LORD put a mark on Cain, so that anyone who found him would not kill him.

verses.kjv: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
verses.modern: Then Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

verses.kjv: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.modern: Cain was intimate with his wife. She conceived and gave birth to Enoch. Then Cain built a city and named it Enoch, after his son.

verses.kjv: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
verses.modern: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad begat Mehujael, and Mehujael begat Methusael, and Methusael begat Lamech.

verses.kjv: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.modern: Lamech took two wives: the name of one was Adah, and the name of the other was Zillah.

verses.kjv: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
verses.modern: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.

verses.kjv: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
verses.modern: His brother's name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.

verses.kjv: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
verses.modern: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal-cain, who forged all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-cain's sister was Naamah.

verses.kjv: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
verses.modern: Lamech said to his wives, 'Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, listen to my words. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for injuring me.

verses.kjv: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
verses.modern: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, then Lamech seventy-sevenfold.'

verses.kjv: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
verses.modern: Adam was intimate with his wife again. She gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, 'God has granted me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him.'

verses.kjv: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: To Seth also a son was born. He named Him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the LORD.

chapters.summary: Cain and Abel brought offerings to the LORD; God accepted Abel's but rejected Cain's, and Cain killed his brother in the field. God cursed Cain to be a wanderer and marked him for protection, and Cain settled in the land of Nod. Adam and Eve had another son, Seth, and through his line men began to call on the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
verses.modern: This is the book of the generations of Adam. On the day that God created man, He made Him in the likeness of God.

verses.kjv: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
verses.modern: Male and female he created them. He blessed them and named them 'Man' on the day they were created.

verses.kjv: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
verses.modern: Adam lived 130 years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

verses.kjv: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days that Adam lived were 930 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
verses.modern: Seth lived 105 years and begat Enosh.

verses.kjv: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days of Seth were 912 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
verses.modern: Enosh lived 90 years and begat Cainan.

verses.kjv: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Cainan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days of Enosh were 905 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:
verses.modern: Cainan lived 70 years and begat Mahalalel.

verses.kjv: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Mahalalel, Cainan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days of Cainan were 910 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
verses.modern: Mahalalel lived 65 years and begat Jared.

verses.kjv: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days of Mahalalel were 895 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
verses.modern: Jared lived 162 years and begat Enoch.

verses.kjv: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days of Jared were 962 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
verses.modern: Enoch lived 65 years and begat Methuselah.

verses.kjv: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
verses.modern: All the days of Enoch were 365 years.

verses.kjv: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
verses.modern: Enoch walked with God, and then He was no more, because God took him.

verses.kjv: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
verses.modern: Methuselah lived 187 years and begat Lamech.

verses.kjv: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days of Methuselah were 969 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
verses.modern: Lamech lived 182 years and begat a son.

verses.kjv: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
verses.modern: He named Him Noah and said, 'This one shall comfort us from our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground the LORD has cursed.'

verses.kjv: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
verses.modern: After he begat Noah, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days of Lamech were 777 years, and then he died.

verses.kjv: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.modern: Noah was 500 years old, and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

chapters.summary: The descendants of Adam are listed from Seth to Noah, recording each patriarch's age at the birth of his firstborn and at death. Enoch walked with God and was taken — he did not die. Noah was born to Lamech, and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
verses.modern: When men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them,

verses.kjv: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
verses.modern: The sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful. They took as wives any of them they chose.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
verses.modern: Then the LORD said, 'My Spirit shall not always strive with man, for He also is flesh; yet His days shall be 120 years.'

verses.kjv: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
verses.modern: There were giants on the earth in those days—and also afterward—when the sons of God went to the daughters of men and had children by them. These were the mighty men of old, men of renown.

verses.kjv: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
verses.modern: GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every intention of the thoughts of His heart was only evil continually.

verses.kjv: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
verses.modern: The LORD repented that He had made man on the earth. It grieved Him to His heart.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
verses.modern: So the LORD said, 'I will blot out man whom I have created from the face of the earth—both man and beast, creeping things, and birds of the air—for I regret that I have made them.'

verses.kjv: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.modern: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.

verses.kjv: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
verses.modern: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generations; Noah walked with God.

verses.kjv: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.modern: Noah begat three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.kjv: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.modern: Now the earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

verses.kjv: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
verses.modern: God looked upon the earth. It was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

verses.kjv: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.modern: God said to Noah, 'The end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I will destroy them along with the earth.

verses.kjv: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
verses.modern: Make yourself an ark of gopher wood. Make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and out with pitch.

verses.kjv: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
verses.modern: This is how you shall make it: The length of the ark shall be 300 cubits, its width 50 cubits, and its height 30 cubits.

verses.kjv: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
verses.modern: Make a window for the ark, finished a cubit from the top. Set the door of the ark in its side, and make it with lower, second, and third decks.

verses.kjv: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
verses.modern: I myself am bringing a flood of waters upon the earth to destroy all flesh under heaven in which is the breath of life. Everything on the earth shall die.

verses.kjv: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.modern: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you shall come into the ark—you, your sons, your wife, and your sons' wives with you.

verses.kjv: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
verses.modern: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every kind into the ark to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.

verses.kjv: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
verses.modern: Of the birds according to their kinds, of the livestock according to their kinds, and of every creeping thing of the ground according to its kind—two of each kind shall come to you to keep them alive.

verses.kjv: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
verses.modern: Also take with you every kind of food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; it shall be food for you and for them.'

verses.kjv: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
verses.modern: Noah did all this; according to all that God had commanded him, so He did.

chapters.summary: The sons of God took the daughters of men as wives, and wickedness filled the earth until every thought of man's heart was only evil. God resolved to destroy all flesh by a flood but found favor in Noah, who was righteous. He commanded Noah to build an ark and bring his family and two of every living creature aboard.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to Noah, 'Come into the ark, you and all your household, for I have seen that you are righteous before me in this generation.

verses.kjv: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.
verses.modern: Of every clean animal You shall take with You seven pairs, the male and His female, and of the animals that are not clean, two, the male and His female.

verses.kjv: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
verses.modern: Also of the birds of the air, seven pairs, male and female, to keep seed alive on the face of all the earth.

verses.kjv: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
verses.modern: For in seven days I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and every living thing I have made I will blot out from the face of the ground.'

verses.kjv: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
verses.modern: Noah did all that the LORD had commanded Him.

verses.kjv: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
verses.modern: Noah was 600 years old when the floodwaters came upon the earth.

verses.kjv: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
verses.modern: Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him went into the ark because of the waters of the flood.

verses.kjv: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
verses.modern: Of clean animals, and of animals that are not clean, and of birds, and of everything that creeps on the ground,

verses.kjv: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.modern: Two and two, male and female, went into the ark with Noah, as God had commanded Noah.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
verses.modern: After seven days, the waters of the flood came upon the earth.

verses.kjv: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
verses.modern: In the 600th year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month—on that very day all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the windows of heaven were opened.

verses.kjv: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.modern: The rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

verses.kjv: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
verses.modern: On that very day Noah entered the ark, along with Shem, Ham, and Japheth, Noah's sons, and Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons,

verses.kjv: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.modern: They and every wild animal according to its kind, all the livestock according to their kinds, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth according to its kind, and every bird according to its kind—every bird of every sort.

verses.kjv: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
verses.modern: They went in to Noah into the ark, two by two of all flesh in which was the breath of life.

verses.kjv: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
verses.modern: Those that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded Him. The LORD shut Him in.

verses.kjv: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
verses.modern: The flood was on the earth forty days, and the waters increased and lifted up the ark. It rose above the earth.

verses.kjv: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
verses.modern: The waters prevailed and increased greatly upon the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the waters.

verses.kjv: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
verses.modern: The waters prevailed so mightily on the earth that all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered.

verses.kjv: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
verses.modern: The waters prevailed above the mountains, covering them fifteen cubits deep.

verses.kjv: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
verses.modern: All flesh that moved on the earth died—birds, livestock, wild animals, all the creeping things that creep on the earth, and every man.

verses.kjv: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
verses.modern: Everything on dry land in whose nostrils was the breath of life died.

verses.kjv: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
verses.modern: He blotted out every living thing that was on the face of the ground—man and animals and creeping things and birds of the air; they were blotted out from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ark.

verses.kjv: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
verses.modern: The waters prevailed upon the earth 150 days.

chapters.summary: The LORD told Noah to enter the ark with his household and the animals, and after seven days the flood came. The fountains of the deep burst open and rain fell for forty days and forty nights, covering even the highest mountains. Every living thing on land died; only Noah and those with him in the ark survived.

verses.kjv: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
verses.modern: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and all the livestock that were with him in the ark. God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters subsided.

verses.kjv: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
verses.modern: The fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were closed, and the rain from heaven was restrained.

verses.kjv: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
verses.modern: The waters receded from the earth continually, and at the end of 150 days the waters had abated.

verses.kjv: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.modern: In the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

verses.kjv: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
verses.modern: The waters continued to decrease until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains became visible.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
verses.modern: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ark he had made.

verses.kjv: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
verses.modern: He sent out a raven, which kept going back and forth until the waters had dried up from the earth.

verses.kjv: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
verses.modern: Then he sent out a dove from him to see if the waters had subsided from the face of the ground.

verses.kjv: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
verses.modern: But the dove found no resting place for the sole of her foot. She returned to him in the ark, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took her and brought her into the ark with him.

verses.kjv: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
verses.modern: He waited another seven days, and again he sent the dove out of the ark.

verses.kjv: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
verses.modern: The dove came back to him in the evening, and in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters had subsided from the earth.

verses.kjv: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
verses.modern: Then he waited another seven days and sent out the dove. But she did not return to him anymore.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.modern: In Noah's 601st year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and the surface of the ground was dry.

verses.kjv: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
verses.modern: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

verses.kjv: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
verses.modern: Then God spoke to Noah, saying,

verses.kjv: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
verses.modern: 'Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons' wives with you.

verses.kjv: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
verses.modern: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh—birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth—so that they may swarm on the earth and be fruitful and multiply on the earth.'

verses.kjv: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
verses.modern: So Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him.

verses.kjv: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
verses.modern: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird—everything that moves on the earth—went out of the ark by families.

verses.kjv: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.modern: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took some of every clean animal and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

verses.kjv: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
verses.modern: The LORD smelled a sweet savour. The LORD said in His heart, 'I will never again curse the ground because of man, for the intention of man's heart is evil from His youth. Neither will I ever again strike down every living thing as I have done.

verses.kjv: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
verses.modern: While the earth remains, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall not cease.'

chapters.summary: God sent a wind over the earth and the floodwaters receded; the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat. Noah sent out a raven and then a dove to test whether the ground was dry, and when the dove did not return he knew the waters had subsided. God told Noah to leave the ark, and Noah built an altar and offered burnt offerings; the LORD vowed never again to curse the ground or destroy every living thing.

verses.kjv: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
verses.modern: God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, 'Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.

verses.kjv: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
verses.modern: The fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, upon every bird of the air, upon everything that creeps on the ground, and upon all the fish of the sea. They are delivered into your hand.

verses.kjv: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
verses.modern: Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you. As I gave you the green plants, so now I give you everything.

verses.kjv: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
verses.modern: But you shall not eat flesh with its life, that is, its blood.

verses.kjv: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
verses.modern: For your lifeblood I will surely demand a reckoning. From every animal I will demand it, and from every man I will demand it—from every man's brother I will demand the life of man.

verses.kjv: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
verses.modern: Whoever sheds man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed, for in the image of God He made man.

verses.kjv: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
verses.modern: As for you, be fruitful and multiply; bring forth abundantly on the earth and multiply in it.'

verses.kjv: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.modern: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him,

verses.kjv: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
verses.modern: ' I establish my covenant with you and with your seed after you,

verses.kjv: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
verses.modern: With every living creature that is with you—the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth with you—all who came out of the ark, every beast of the earth.

verses.kjv: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
verses.modern: I establish my covenant with you: never again shall all flesh be cut off by the waters of a flood, and never again shall there be a flood to destroy the earth.'

verses.kjv: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.modern: God said, 'This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, for all future generations:

verses.kjv: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
verses.modern: I have set my bow in the clouds. It shall be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
verses.modern: Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the bow appears in the clouds,

verses.kjv: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.modern: I will remember my covenant between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters shall never again become a flood to destroy all flesh.

verses.kjv: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.modern: The bow shall be in the clouds. I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.'

verses.kjv: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
verses.modern: God said to Noah, 'This is the sign of the covenant I have established between me and all flesh on the earth.'

verses.kjv: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
verses.modern: The sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham was the father of Canaan.

verses.kjv: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
verses.modern: These three were the sons of Noah, and from them the people of the whole earth were dispersed.

verses.kjv: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
verses.modern: Noah began to be a farmer. He planted a vineyard.

verses.kjv: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
verses.modern: He drank of the wine and became drunk. He lay uncovered in his tent.

verses.kjv: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
verses.modern: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father and told his two brothers outside.

verses.kjv: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
verses.modern: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment, laid it on both their shoulders, and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were turned away. They did not see their father's nakedness.

verses.kjv: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
verses.modern: When Noah awoke from his wine and knew what his youngest son had done to him,

verses.kjv: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
verses.modern: He said, 'Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be to his brothers.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.modern: He also He said, 'Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem, and let Canaan be his servant.

verses.kjv: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
verses.modern: May God enlarge Japheth, and let him dwell in the tents of Shem, and let Canaan be his servant.'

verses.kjv: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.modern: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.

verses.kjv: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
verses.modern: All the days of Noah were 950 years, and then he died.

chapters.summary: God blessed Noah and his sons, permitted them to eat meat but forbade eating blood, and established the rainbow as the sign of his covenant never to destroy the earth by flood again. Noah planted a vineyard, became drunk, and lay uncovered in his tent; Ham saw his nakedness, but Shem and Japheth covered him. When Noah awoke he cursed Canaan and blessed Shem and Japheth.

verses.kjv: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
verses.modern: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

verses.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.modern: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.modern: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.modern: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.kjv: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
verses.modern: From these the coastland peoples spread into their territories, each with its own language, by their clans, in their nations.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
verses.modern: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Phut, and Canaan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.modern: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.modern: Cush begat Nimrod; He was the first on earth to be a mighty man.

verses.kjv: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
verses.modern: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; therefore it is said, 'Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.modern: The beginning of His kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

verses.kjv: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
verses.modern: From that land He went to Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,

verses.kjv: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
verses.modern: Resen between Nineveh and Calah—that is the great city.

verses.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.modern: Mizraim begat the Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

verses.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
verses.modern: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom the Philistines came), and Caphtorim.

verses.kjv: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.modern: Canaan begat Sidon His firstborn, and Heth,

verses.kjv: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
verses.modern: The Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgasite,

verses.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.modern: The Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

verses.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
verses.modern: The Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

verses.kjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
verses.modern: The territory of the Canaanites extended from Sidon in the direction of Gerar as far as Gaza, and in the direction of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, as far as Lasha.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Ham, by their clans, by their languages, in their lands, in their nations.

verses.kjv: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
verses.modern: To Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the older brother of Japheth, children were born.

verses.kjv: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
verses.modern: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.

verses.kjv: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
verses.modern: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

verses.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
verses.modern: Arphaxad begat Salah, and Salah begat Eber.

verses.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
verses.modern: To Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother's name was Joktan.

verses.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.modern: Joktan begat Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.kjv: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.modern: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.kjv: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.modern: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.modern: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.

verses.kjv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
verses.modern: Their dwelling place extended from Mesha in the direction of Sephar, the hill country of the east.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Shem, by their clans, by their languages, in their lands, by their nations.

verses.kjv: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
verses.modern: These are the clans of the sons of Noah, according to their generations, in their nations, and from these the nations spread abroad on the earth after the flood.

chapters.summary: The descendants of Noah's three sons — Japheth, Ham, and Shem — are listed as the nations that spread across the earth after the flood. Nimrod, a descendant of Ham, became the first mighty man and empire-builder, founding Babel and Nineveh. From these clans the nations divided into their territories, each with its own language.

verses.kjv: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
verses.modern: Now the whole earth had one language and one speech.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.modern: As people journeyed from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.

verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
verses.modern: They said to one another, 'Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly.' They used brick for stone and tar for mortar.

verses.kjv: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.modern: Then they said, 'Come, let us build ourselves a city and a tower with its top in the heavens, and let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered across the face of the whole earth.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.modern: But the LORD came down to see the city and the tower which the sons of men had built.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
verses.modern: The LORD said, ' The people are one. They all have one language, and this is only the beginning of what they will do. Now nothing they plan to do will be withheld from them.

verses.kjv: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
verses.modern: Come, let us go down and confuse their language there, so that they will not understand one another's speech.'

verses.kjv: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
verses.modern: So the LORD scattered them from there over the face of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

verses.kjv: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.modern: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there the LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth.

verses.kjv: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
verses.modern: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was 100 years old and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood.

verses.kjv: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.modern: After he begat Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
verses.modern: Arphaxad lived 35 years and begat Salah.

verses.kjv: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.modern: After he begat Salah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
verses.modern: Salah lived 30 years and begat Eber.

verses.kjv: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.modern: After he begat Eber, Salah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
verses.modern: Eber lived 34 years and begat Peleg.

verses.kjv: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.modern: After he begat Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
verses.modern: Peleg lived 30 years and begat Reu.

verses.kjv: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.modern: After he begat Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
verses.modern: Reu lived 32 years and begat Serug.

verses.kjv: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.modern: After he begat Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
verses.modern: Serug lived 30 years and begat Nahor.

verses.kjv: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.modern: After he begat Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
verses.modern: Nahor lived 29 years and begat Terah.

verses.kjv: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.modern: After he begat Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.modern: Terah lived 70 years and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

verses.kjv: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
verses.modern: Now these are the generations of Terah. Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran begat Lot.

verses.kjv: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.modern: Haran died during the lifetime of his father Terah in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldees.

verses.kjv: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.modern: Abram and Nahor took wives. The name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was the father of Milcah and Iscah.

verses.kjv: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.modern: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

verses.kjv: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.modern: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai the wife of his son Abram, and they set out together from Ur of the Chaldees to go to the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and settled there.

verses.kjv: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.modern: The days of Terah were 205 years, and Terah died in Haran.

chapters.summary: The whole earth shared one language, and the people built a city and tower at Babel to make a name for themselves; the LORD confused their language and scattered them across the earth. The descendants of Shem are listed from Arphaxad to Abram. Terah took his son Abram, Abram's wife Sarai, and his grandson Lot from Ur of the Chaldees toward Canaan, but they settled in Haran, where Terah died.

verses.kjv: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
verses.modern: Now the LORD had said to Abram, 'Leave your country, your relatives, and your father's house, and go to the land I will show you.

verses.kjv: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
verses.modern: I will make You into a great nation. I will bless You and make Your name great, and You will be a blessing.

verses.kjv: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
verses.modern: I will bless those who bless You, and curse the one who curses you. In you all the families of the earth shall be blessed.'

verses.kjv: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
verses.modern: So Abram went, as the LORD had told Him, and Lot went with him. Abram was 75 years old when he left Haran.

verses.kjv: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
