verses.modern: Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all their possessions they had gathered, and the people they had acquired in Haran. They set out for the land of Canaan. When they came to the land of Canaan,

verses.kjv: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
verses.modern: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.

verses.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
verses.modern: Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, 'To your seed I will give this land.' So He built there an altar to the LORD, Who had appeared to Him.

verses.kjv: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: From there He moved to the mountain east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There He built an altar to the LORD and called on the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
verses.modern: Then Abram continued his journey, going on toward the south.

verses.kjv: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
verses.modern: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to stay there, for the famine was severe in the land.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
verses.modern: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, 'Look, I know that you are a beautiful woman.

verses.kjv: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
verses.modern: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, This is his wife. They will kill me but let you live.

verses.kjv: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
verses.modern: Please say you are my sister, so that it will go well with me for your sake, and my life will be spared because of you.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
verses.modern: When Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

verses.kjv: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
verses.modern: Pharaoh's officials saw her and praised her to Pharaoh, and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

verses.kjv: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
verses.modern: He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep, oxen, male donkeys, male and female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

verses.kjv: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
verses.modern: But the LORD struck Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
verses.modern: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and said, 'What is this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?

verses.kjv: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
verses.modern: Why did you say, She is my sister, so that I took her for my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go.'

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
verses.modern: Pharaoh gave orders to his men concerning him. They sent him away with his wife and all that he had.

chapters.summary: The LORD called Abram to leave his country and go to a land he would show him, promising to make him a great nation. Abram obeyed, traveled through Canaan, and built altars at Shechem and Bethel. A famine drove him to Egypt, where he told Sarai to say she was his sister; Pharaoh took her into his house but was struck with plagues and sent them away.

verses.kjv: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
verses.modern: So Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

verses.kjv: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
verses.modern: Now Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

verses.kjv: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
verses.modern: He journeyed on by stages from the south as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

verses.kjv: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
verses.modern: To the place of the altar that He had made there at first. And there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
verses.modern: Lot, who went with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.

verses.kjv: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
verses.modern: The land could not support them dwelling together, for their possessions were so great that they could not remain together.

verses.kjv: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
verses.modern: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were dwelling in the land.

verses.kjv: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
verses.modern: So Abram said to Lot, 'Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen, for we are brothers.

verses.kjv: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
verses.modern: Is not the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you take the left, then I will go to the right; or if you take the right, then I will go to the left.'

verses.kjv: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
verses.modern: Lot lifted up his eyes and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan was well watered everywhere—before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah—like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as You go toward Zoar.

verses.kjv: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
verses.modern: So Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan, and Lot journeyed east. Thus they separated from each other.

verses.kjv: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
verses.modern: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and pitched his tent near Sodom.

verses.kjv: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
verses.modern: Now the men of Sodom were wicked, great sinners against the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
verses.modern: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him, 'Now lift up your eyes and look from the place where you are, northward, southward, eastward, and westward.

verses.kjv: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
verses.modern: For all the land which You see, I will give to You and to Your seed forever.

verses.kjv: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
verses.modern: I will make Your seed as the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust of the earth, then your seed could also be counted.

verses.kjv: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
verses.modern: Arise, walk through the land in its length and its breadth, for I will give it to You.'

verses.kjv: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
verses.modern: So Abram moved his tent and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and there He built an altar to the LORD.

chapters.summary: Abram returned from Egypt to Canaan, wealthy in livestock, silver, and gold, but strife arose between his herdsmen and Lot's because the land could not support them both. Abram let Lot choose first; Lot chose the well-watered plain of the Jordan and settled near Sodom. The LORD promised Abram all the land he could see and seed as numerous as the dust of the earth, and Abram settled by the oaks of Mamre in Hebron.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
verses.modern: In the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations,

verses.kjv: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
verses.modern: these kings made war with Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).

verses.kjv: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
verses.modern: All these joined forces in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea).

verses.kjv: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.modern: Twelve years they had served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

verses.kjv: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
verses.modern: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,

verses.kjv: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.
verses.modern: the Horites in their Mount Seir, as far as El-paran on the border of the wilderness.

verses.kjv: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
verses.modern: Then they turned back and came to En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh) and struck down all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.

verses.kjv: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
verses.modern: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) went out and joined battle in the Valley of Siddim

verses.kjv: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
verses.modern: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of nations, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.

verses.kjv: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
verses.modern: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and as the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some fell into them, and the rest fled to the hill country.

verses.kjv: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
verses.modern: So the enemy took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their provisions and went their way.

verses.kjv: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.modern: They also took Lot, Abram's nephew, who was dwelling in Sodom, along with his possessions, and left.

verses.kjv: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
verses.modern: Then one who had escaped came and told Abram the Hebrew, who was dwelling by the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner; these were allies of Abram.

verses.kjv: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
verses.modern: When Abram heard that his kinsman had been taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his own house, 318 of them, and pursued as far as Dan.

verses.kjv: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
verses.modern: He divided his forces against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them down, and pursued them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.

verses.kjv: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
verses.modern: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his kinsman Lot with his possessions, and the women and the people.

verses.kjv: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
verses.modern: After his return from the defeat of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him at the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King's Valley).

verses.kjv: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
verses.modern: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

verses.kjv: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
verses.modern: He blessed Abram and said, 'Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth,

verses.kjv: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
verses.modern: blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.' And Abram gave him a tenth of everything.

verses.kjv: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
verses.modern: the king of Sodom said to Abram, 'Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.'

verses.kjv: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.modern: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, 'I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth,

verses.kjv: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
verses.modern: that I will not take a thread or a sandal strap or anything that is yours, lest you should say, I have made Abram rich.

verses.kjv: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
verses.modern: I will take nothing but what the young men have eaten, and the share of the men who went with me—Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their share.'

chapters.summary: Four eastern kings led by Chedorlaomer defeated the five kings of the Jordan plain and carried off Lot and his possessions from Sodom. Abram armed 318 trained men, pursued the invaders as far as Dan, and recovered Lot and all the goods. Melchizedek king of Salem blessed Abram and received a tenth of everything from him, while Abram refused to take anything from the king of Sodom.

verses.kjv: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
verses.modern: After these things the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision, saying, 'Do not fear, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.'

verses.kjv: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
verses.modern: But Abram said, 'Lord GOD, what will You give me, since I go childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?'

verses.kjv: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
verses.modern: Abram said, ' you have given me no seed, and a servant born in my house is my heir.'

verses.kjv: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
verses.modern: Then the word of the LORD came to Him, saying, 'This man shall not be your heir; your own son shall be Your heir.'

verses.kjv: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
verses.modern: He brought Him outside and said, 'Look now toward the heavens and count the stars, if You are able to count them.' Then He said to Him, 'So shall Your seed be.'

verses.kjv: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
verses.modern: Abram believed the LORD. He counted it to Him as righteousness.

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
verses.modern: He said to Him, 'I am the LORD Who brought You out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give You this land to inherit it.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
verses.modern: But Abram said, 'Lord GOD, how shall I know that I will inherit it?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
verses.modern: He said to Him, 'Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.'

verses.kjv: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
verses.modern: So He brought Him all these, cut them in two, and laid each half opposite the other. But He did not cut the birds in two.

verses.kjv: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
verses.modern: When birds of prey came down on the carcasses, Abram drove them away.

verses.kjv: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
verses.modern: As the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram, and a dreadful great darkness fell upon him.

verses.kjv: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
verses.modern: Then he said to Abram, 'Know for certain that your seed will be sojourners in a land that is not theirs. They will be servants there. They will be afflicted for 400 years.

verses.kjv: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
verses.modern: But I will also judge the nation whom they serve, and afterward they shall come out with great possessions.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
verses.modern: As for you, you shall go to your fathers in peace; you shall be buried at a good old age.

verses.kjv: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
verses.modern: In the fourth generation they shall come back here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
verses.modern: When the sun had gone down and it was dark, a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

verses.kjv: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.modern: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, 'To your seed I have given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates,

verses.kjv: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
verses.modern: The Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

verses.kjv: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
verses.modern: The Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

verses.kjv: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
verses.modern: The Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.'

chapters.summary: The LORD appeared to Abram in a vision, promised him an heir from his own body, and told him to count the stars — so would his seed be. Abram believed the LORD, and it was counted to him as righteousness. God made a covenant with Abram, foretelling that his descendants would be strangers and servants in a foreign land for 400 years before returning to possess the land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates.

verses.kjv: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
verses.modern: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, had borne him no children. She had an Egyptian maidservant whose name was Hagar.

verses.kjv: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.modern: So Sarai said to Abram, ' now, the LORD has kept me from bearing children. Please go in to my maidservant; perhaps I can obtain children through her.' And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

verses.kjv: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
verses.modern: So Sarai, Abram's wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her maidservant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

verses.kjv: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
verses.modern: He went in to Hagar. She conceived. And when she saw that she had conceived, she looked with contempt on her mistress.

verses.kjv: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.
verses.modern: Then Sarai said to Abram, 'May the wrong done to me be on you. I gave my maidservant into your embrace, and when she saw that she had conceived, she looked on me with contempt. May the LORD judge between You and me.'

verses.kjv: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
verses.modern: But Abram said to Sarai, ' your maidservant is in your hand; do to her as you please.' Then Sarai dealt harshly with her. She fled from her presence.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, the spring on the way to Shur.

verses.kjv: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
verses.modern: He said, 'Hagar, Sarai's maidservant, where have You come from, and where are You going?' She said, 'I am fleeing from the presence of my mistress Sarai.'

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD said to her, 'Return to Your mistress and submit Yourself under her hand.'

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD also said to her, 'I will greatly multiply Your seed so that they shall be too numerous to count.'

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD said to her, 'You are with child and shall bear a son. You shall call His name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard Your affliction.

verses.kjv: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.modern: He shall be a wild man; His hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him. He shall dwell in the presence of all His brothers.'

verses.kjv: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
verses.modern: So she called the name of the LORD Who spoke to her, 'You are the God Who sees me,' for she said, 'Have I really seen here Him who sees me?'

verses.kjv: Wherefore the well was called Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.modern: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; it is between Kadesh and Bered.

verses.kjv: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
verses.modern: Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

verses.kjv: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
verses.modern: Abram was 86 years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

chapters.summary: Sarai, still childless, gave her Egyptian maidservant Hagar to Abram as a wife; Hagar conceived and began to despise Sarai. Sarai dealt harshly with Hagar, who fled into the wilderness, where the angel of the LORD found her and told her to return, promising her son would father a multitude. Hagar bore Abram a son, and he named him Ishmael.

verses.kjv: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
verses.modern: When Abram was 99 years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, 'I am God Almighty; walk before me and be blameless.

verses.kjv: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
verses.modern: I will make my covenant between me and You, and will multiply You greatly.'

verses.kjv: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
verses.modern: Then Abram fell on his face. God spoke with Him, saying,

verses.kjv: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
verses.modern: 'As for me, my covenant is with you, and you shall be the father of many nations.

verses.kjv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
verses.modern: No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham, for I have made you the father of many nations.

verses.kjv: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
verses.modern: I will make you greatly fruitful. I will make nations of you, and kings shall come from you.

verses.kjv: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
verses.modern: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your seed after you.

verses.kjv: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
verses.modern: I will give to you and to your seed after you the land of your sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.'

verses.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
verses.modern: God said to Abraham, 'As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your seed after you throughout their generations.

verses.kjv: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
verses.modern: This is my covenant which you shall keep, between me and you and your seed after you: every male among you shall be circumcised.

verses.kjv: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
verses.modern: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It shall be a sign of the covenant between me and you.

verses.kjv: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
verses.modern: He who is eight days old among you shall be circumcised, every male throughout your generations, whether born in your house or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your seed.

verses.kjv: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.modern: Both he who is born in your house and he who is bought with your money must be circumcised. So my covenant shall be in your flesh as an everlasting covenant.

verses.kjv: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
verses.modern: Any uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin shall be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant.'

verses.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
verses.modern: God said to Abraham, 'As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall be her name.

verses.kjv: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
verses.modern: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. I will bless her. She shall become nations; kings of peoples shall come from her.'

verses.kjv: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
verses.modern: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, 'Shall a child be born to a man who is 100 years old? Shall Sarah, who is 90 years old, bear a child?'

verses.kjv: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
verses.modern: Abraham said to God, 'Oh that Ishmael might live before you!'

verses.kjv: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
verses.modern: But God said, 'Sarah your wife shall indeed bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

verses.kjv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.modern: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. I have blessed him. I will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He shall father twelve princes. I will make him a great nation.

verses.kjv: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
verses.modern: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this set time next year.'

verses.kjv: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.modern: When he had finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

verses.kjv: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
verses.modern: Then Abraham took Ishmael his son and all those born in his house and all those bought with his money—every male among the men of Abraham's house—and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin that very day, as God had said to him.

verses.kjv: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.modern: Abraham was 99 years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.kjv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.modern: Ishmael his son was 13 years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.kjv: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
verses.modern: That very day Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised.

verses.kjv: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
verses.modern: All the men of his house, those born in the house and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

chapters.summary: When Abram was 99, the LORD appeared and established the covenant of circumcision, renaming him Abraham and Sarai as Sarah. God promised that Sarah would bear a son named Isaac, through whom the everlasting covenant would continue. Abraham circumcised every male in his household that same day, as God had commanded.

verses.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
verses.modern: The LORD appeared to Abraham by the oaks of Mamre as he sat at the tent door in the heat of the day.

verses.kjv: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
verses.modern: He lifted up His eyes and looked, and three men stood in front of Him. When He saw them, He ran from the tent door to meet them and bowed Himself to the ground.

verses.kjv: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
verses.modern: He said, 'My Lord, if I have found favor in Your sight, please do not pass by Your servant.

verses.kjv: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
verses.modern: Let a little water be brought, and wash Your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree,

verses.kjv: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
verses.modern: while I bring a morsel of bread, that You may refresh yourselves; after that You may pass on—since You have come to Your servant.' And they said, 'Do as You have said.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
verses.modern: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said, 'Quick, three measures of fine flour! Knead it and make cakes.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
verses.modern: Abraham ran to the herd, took a tender and good calf, and gave it to a young man, who hurried to prepare it.

verses.kjv: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
verses.modern: Then he took curds and milk and the calf that he had prepared, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree while they ate.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
verses.modern: They said to him, 'Where is Sarah your wife?' And he said, ' in the tent.'

verses.kjv: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.modern: The LORD said, 'I will surely return to You about this time next year, and Sarah your wife shall have a son.' And Sarah was listening at the tent door behind him.

verses.kjv: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
verses.modern: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in age; it had ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

verses.kjv: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
verses.modern: So Sarah laughed to herself, saying, 'After I have grown old, shall I have pleasure, my lord also being old?'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
verses.modern: The LORD said to Abraham, 'Why did Sarah laugh and say, Shall I indeed bear a child, now that I am old?

verses.kjv: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
verses.modern: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to You, about this time next year, and Sarah shall have a son.'

verses.kjv: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
verses.modern: But Sarah denied it, saying, 'I did not laugh,' for she was afraid. And he said, 'No, but you did laugh.'

verses.kjv: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
verses.modern: Then the men set out from there and looked toward Sodom, and Abraham went with them to send them on their way.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
verses.modern: The LORD said, 'Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do,

verses.kjv: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.modern: seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation. All the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

verses.kjv: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
verses.modern: For I have chosen Him, that He may command His children and his household after Him to keep the way of the LORD by doing righteousness and justice, so that the LORD may bring to Abraham what he has promised him.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
verses.modern: Then the LORD said, 'Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great and their sin is very grievous,

verses.kjv: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
verses.modern: I will go down now and see whether they have done altogether according to the outcry that has come to me. If not, I will know.'

verses.kjv: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
verses.modern: So the men turned from there and went toward Sodom, but Abraham still stood before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.modern: Then Abraham drew near and said, 'Will you indeed sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

verses.kjv: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
verses.modern: Suppose there are fifty righteous within the city. Will you indeed sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous who are in it?

verses.kjv: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
verses.modern: Far be it from you to do such a thing—to slay the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous fare as the wicked! Far be it from you! Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?'

verses.kjv: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
verses.modern: The LORD said, 'If I find at Sodom fifty righteous in the city, I will spare the whole place for their sake.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
verses.modern: Abraham answered and said, ' I have taken upon myself to speak to the Lord, though I am but dust and ashes.

verses.kjv: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
verses.modern: Suppose five of the fifty righteous are lacking. Will you destroy the whole city for lack of five?' And he said, 'I will not destroy it if I find 45 there.'

verses.kjv: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.
verses.modern: Again he spoke to him and said, 'Suppose 40 are found there.' He answered, 'I will not do it for the sake of 40.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
verses.modern: Then he said, 'Let not the Lord be angry. I will speak. Suppose 30 are found there.' He answered, 'I will not do it if I find 30 there.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.
verses.modern: He said, ' I have taken upon myself to speak to the Lord. Suppose 20 are found there.' He answered, 'For the sake of 20 I will not destroy it.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.
verses.modern: Then he said, 'Let not the Lord be angry. I will speak just once more. Suppose 10 are found there.' He answered, 'For the sake of 10 I will not destroy it.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
verses.modern: The LORD went on His way as soon as He had finished speaking with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

chapters.summary: Three visitors came to Abraham at the oaks of Mamre; he prepared a meal for them, and the LORD promised that Sarah would bear a son within a year — Sarah laughed when she heard it. The LORD revealed to Abraham his plan to judge Sodom and Gomorrah, and Abraham interceded, bargaining the LORD down from fifty righteous to ten as grounds for sparing the city.

verses.kjv: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
verses.modern: The two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gate of Sodom. When Lot saw them, he rose to meet them and bowed himself with his face to the ground.

verses.kjv: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
verses.modern: He said, ' now, my lords, please turn aside to your servant's house and spend the night and wash your feet. Then you may rise up early and go on your way.' They said, 'No; we will spend the night in the square.'

verses.kjv: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
verses.modern: But he urged them strongly, so they turned aside to him and entered his house. He made them a feast and baked unleavened bread. They ate.

verses.kjv: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
verses.modern: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

verses.kjv: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
verses.modern: They called to Lot and said to him, 'Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us, that we may know them.'

verses.kjv: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
verses.modern: Lot went out to them at the door, shutting the door behind him,

verses.kjv: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
verses.modern: said, 'I beg you, my brothers, do not act so wickedly.

verses.kjv: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
verses.modern: I have two daughters who have not known a man. Let me bring them out to you, and do to them as is good in your eyes. Only do nothing to these men, for they have come under the shelter of my roof.'

verses.kjv: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
verses.modern: But they said, 'Stand back!' And they said, 'This fellow came in to stay. He would be our judge! Now we will deal worse with you than with them.' Then they pressed hard against the man Lot and drew near to break the door.

verses.kjv: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
verses.modern: But the men reached out their hands and pulled Lot into the house with them and shut the door.

verses.kjv: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
verses.modern: They struck the men at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wore themselves out trying to find the door.

verses.kjv: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
verses.modern: Then the men said to Lot, 'Have you anyone else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, or anyone you have in the city, bring them out of the place.

verses.kjv: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.
verses.modern: For we are about to destroy this place, because the outcry against them has become great before the LORD. The LORD has sent us to destroy it.'

verses.kjv: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
verses.modern: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were to marry His daughters, and said, 'Get up, get out of this place, for the LORD is about to destroy the city.' But He seemed to His sons-in-law to be jesting.

verses.kjv: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
verses.modern: When the morning dawned, the angels urged Lot, saying, 'Arise, take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city.'

verses.kjv: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
verses.modern: But He lingered. So the men seized His hand and the hand of his wife and the hands of His two daughters, the LORD being merciful to Him. They brought Him out and set Him outside the city.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
verses.modern: When they had brought them outside, He said, 'Escape for Your life. Do not look behind You, and do not stop anywhere in the plain. Escape to the hills, lest You be swept away.'

verses.kjv: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:
verses.modern: But Lot said to them, 'Oh, no, my lord!

verses.kjv: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
verses.modern: your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great mercy in saving my life. But I cannot escape to the hills, lest the disaster overtake me and I die.

verses.kjv: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
verses.modern: this city is near enough to flee to. It is a little one. Let me escape there—is it not a little one?—and my life shall be saved.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
verses.modern: He said to him, ' I grant you this favor also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

verses.kjv: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.modern: Hurry, escape there, for I can do nothing until you arrive there.' Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

verses.kjv: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
verses.modern: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

verses.kjv: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
verses.modern: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of heaven.

verses.kjv: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
verses.modern: He overthrew those cities and all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew on the ground.

verses.kjv: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.modern: But Lot's wife looked back from behind him. She became a pillar of salt.

verses.kjv: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:
verses.modern: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where He had stood before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
verses.modern: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and toward all the land of the plain. He saw the smoke of the land going up like the smoke of a furnace.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
verses.modern: So it was, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow when he overthrew the cities in which Lot had lived.

verses.kjv: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.modern: Then Lot went up out of Zoar and lived in the hills with his two daughters, for he was afraid to dwell in Zoar. He and his two daughters lived in a cave.

verses.kjv: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
verses.modern: The firstborn said to the younger, 'Our father is old, and there is not a man on earth to come in to us after the manner of all the earth.

verses.kjv: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.modern: Come, let us make our father drink wine. We will lie with him, that we may preserve seed from our father.'

verses.kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.modern: So they made their father drink wine that night, and the firstborn went in and lay with her father. He did not know when she lay down or when she arose.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
verses.modern: The next day the firstborn said to the younger, ' I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine tonight also, and you go in and lie with him, that we may preserve seed from our father.'

verses.kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
verses.modern: So they made their father drink wine that night also, and the younger arose and lay with him. He did not know when she lay down or when she arose.

verses.kjv: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
verses.modern: Thus both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father.

verses.kjv: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
verses.modern: The firstborn bore a son and called his name Moab; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.

verses.kjv: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
verses.modern: The younger also bore a son and called his name Ben-ammi; he is the father of the Ammonites to this day.

chapters.summary: Two angels came to Sodom, and Lot took them in; the men of the city surrounded the house demanding the visitors, but the angels struck the mob with blindness and urged Lot to flee. The LORD rained fire and sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah, destroying the cities of the plain; Lot's wife looked back and became a pillar of salt. Lot and his two daughters escaped to a cave in the hills, where his daughters bore him sons — Moab and Ben-ammi, fathers of the Moabites and Ammonites.

verses.kjv: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
verses.modern: From there Abraham journeyed toward the south country and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He stayed in Gerar.

verses.kjv: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
verses.modern: Abraham said of Sarah his wife, 'She is my sister.' And Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.

verses.kjv: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
verses.modern: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night and said to Him, ' you are a dead man because of the woman you have taken, for she is a man's wife.'

verses.kjv: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
verses.modern: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, 'Lord, will you slay even a righteous nation?

verses.kjv: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
verses.modern: Did he not himself say to me, She is my sister? And she herself said, He is my brother. In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands I have done this.'

verses.kjv: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
verses.modern: Then God said to Him in the dream, 'Yes, I know that you did this in the integrity of your heart. It was I who kept you from sinning against me. Therefore I did not let you touch her.

verses.kjv: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
verses.modern: Now therefore return the man's wife, for he is a prophet. He will pray for you, and you shall live. But if you do not return her, know that you shall surely die, you and all who are yours.'

verses.kjv: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
verses.modern: So Abimelech rose early in the morning and called all his servants and told them all these things in their hearing. The men were very afraid.

verses.kjv: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
verses.modern: Then Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, 'What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and my kingdom a great sin? You have done to me things that ought not to be done.'

verses.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
verses.modern: Abimelech said to Abraham, 'What did you see, that you did this thing?'

verses.kjv: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
verses.modern: Abraham said, 'Because I thought, Surely there is no fear of God in this place. They will kill me because of my wife.

verses.kjv: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.modern: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father though not the daughter of my mother. She became my wife.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
verses.modern: when God caused me to wander from my father's house, I said to her, This is the kindness you must do for me: at every place we come to, say of me, He is my brother.'

verses.kjv: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
verses.modern: Then Abimelech took sheep and oxen and male and female servants and gave them to Abraham, and returned Sarah his wife to him.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
verses.modern: Abimelech said, ' my land is before you; dwell where it pleases you.'

verses.kjv: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
verses.modern: To Sarah he said, 'I have given your brother 1,000 pieces of silver. It is a covering of the eyes for you before all who are with you, and before everyone. Thus she was reproved.'

verses.kjv: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
verses.modern: Then Abraham prayed to God. God healed Abimelech and his wife and female servants. They bore children.

verses.kjv: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
verses.modern: For the LORD had closed fast all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.

chapters.summary: Abraham moved to Gerar and again said Sarah was his sister; Abimelech king of Gerar took Sarah, but God warned him in a dream that she was another man's wife. Abimelech restored Sarah to Abraham along with livestock and servants. Abraham prayed, and God healed Abimelech and his household.

verses.kjv: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
verses.modern: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said. The LORD did to Sarah as he had promised.

verses.kjv: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.modern: Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age at the appointed time of which God had spoken to him.

verses.kjv: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
verses.modern: Abraham called the name of his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore him, Isaac.

verses.kjv: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.modern: Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

verses.kjv: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
verses.modern: Abraham was 100 years old when his son Isaac was born to him.

verses.kjv: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
verses.modern: Sarah said, 'God has made me laugh; everyone who hears will laugh with me.'

verses.kjv: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
verses.modern: She also said, 'Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.'

verses.kjv: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.modern: The child grew and was weaned, and Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

verses.kjv: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
verses.modern: But Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

verses.kjv: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
verses.modern: So she said to Abraham, 'Cast out this bondwoman and her son, for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son Isaac.'

verses.kjv: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
verses.modern: The thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight on account of his son.

verses.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.modern: But God said to Abraham, 'Do not let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy and because of your bondwoman. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice, for through Isaac shall your seed be named.

verses.kjv: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
verses.modern: also of the son of the bondwoman I will make a nation, because he is your seed.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.modern: So Abraham rose early in the morning, took bread and a skin of water, and gave them to Hagar, putting them on her shoulder, along with the child, and sent her away. She departed and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

verses.kjv: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
verses.modern: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the child under one of the shrubs.

verses.kjv: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
verses.modern: Then she went and sat down opposite him a good way off, about a bowshot, for she said, 'Let me not see the death of the child.' And she sat opposite him and lifted up her voice and wept.

verses.kjv: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
verses.modern: God heard the voice of the boy, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, 'What troubles you, Hagar? Do not fear, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

verses.kjv: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
verses.modern: Arise, lift up the boy and hold him by the hand, for I will make him a great nation.'

verses.kjv: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
verses.modern: Then God opened her eyes. She saw a well of water. She went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.

verses.kjv: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.modern: God was with the boy. He grew up. He lived in the wilderness and became an archer.

verses.kjv: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
verses.modern: At that time Abimelech and Phichol, the commander of his army, spoke to Abraham, saying, 'God is with you in all that you do.

verses.kjv: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
verses.modern: Now therefore swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me or with my children or with my descendants. According to the kindness I have shown you, you shall show to me and to the land where you have stayed.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham said, I will swear.
verses.modern: Abraham said, 'I will swear.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
verses.modern: Then Abraham rebuked Abimelech because of a well of water that Abimelech's servants had seized by force.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
verses.modern: Abimelech said, 'I do not know who has done this thing. You did not tell me. I have not heard of it until today.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
verses.modern: So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them made a covenant.

verses.kjv: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.modern: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

verses.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
verses.modern: Abimelech said to Abraham, 'What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs that you have set by themselves?'

verses.kjv: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
verses.modern: He said, 'These seven ewe lambs you shall take from my hand, that they may be a witness for me that I dug this well.'

verses.kjv: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
verses.modern: Therefore that place was called Beersheba, because there the two of them swore an oath.

verses.kjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
verses.modern: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Then Abimelech rose up, with Phichol the commander of his army. They returned to the land of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
verses.modern: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and called there on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.

verses.kjv: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
verses.modern: Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines many days.

chapters.summary: Sarah bore Isaac to Abraham in his old age, just as God had promised. Sarah demanded that Hagar and Ishmael be cast out; God told Abraham to listen to her and promised to make Ishmael a nation as well. God provided water for Hagar in the wilderness, and Abraham made a covenant with Abimelech at Beersheba.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
verses.modern: After these things God tempted Abraham and said to him, 'Abraham!' And he said, 'Here I am.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
verses.modern: He said, 'Take now your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
verses.modern: So Abraham rose early in the morning, saddled his donkey, took two of his young men with him and Isaac his son, split the wood for the burnt offering, and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.

verses.kjv: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
verses.modern: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw the place from afar.

verses.kjv: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
verses.modern: Abraham said to his young men, 'Stay here with the donkey. I and the boy will go over there and worship. We will come back to you.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
verses.modern: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took the fire in his hand and the knife, and the two of them walked on together.

verses.kjv: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
verses.modern: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father and said, 'My father!' And he said, 'Here I am, my son.' He said, ' the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?'

verses.kjv: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
verses.modern: Abraham said, 'My son, God will provide for himself the lamb for a burnt offering.' So the two of them walked on together.

verses.kjv: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
verses.modern: When they came to the place of which God had told him, Abraham built the altar there and laid the wood in order. He bound Isaac his son and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.

verses.kjv: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.modern: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
verses.modern: But the angel of the LORD called to Him from heaven and said, 'Abraham, Abraham!' And he said, 'Here I am.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
verses.modern: He said, 'Do not lay Your hand on the boy, and do nothing to him. For now I know that You fear God, since You have not withheld Your son, Your only son, from me.'

verses.kjv: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
verses.modern: Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and behind him was a ram caught in a thicket by its horns. Abraham went and took the ram and offered it up as a burnt offering in place of his son.

verses.kjv: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
verses.modern: So Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh, as it is said to this day, 'In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.'

verses.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
verses.modern: The angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time,

verses.kjv: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
verses.modern: said, 'By myself I have sworn, declares the LORD, because You have done this thing and have not withheld Your son, Your only son,

verses.kjv: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
verses.modern: that I will surely bless You. I will surely multiply Your seed as the stars of the heavens and as the sand on the seashore. And Your seed shall possess the gate of their enemies,

verses.kjv: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
verses.modern: in Your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because You have obeyed my voice.'

verses.kjv: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
verses.modern: So Abraham returned to his young men. They arose and went together to Beersheba. And Abraham lived at Beersheba.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
verses.modern: After these things it was told Abraham, ' Milcah also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

verses.kjv: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
verses.modern: Huz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

verses.kjv: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
verses.modern: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.'

verses.kjv: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
verses.modern: Bethuel begat Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

verses.kjv: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
verses.modern: his concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Thahash, and Maachah.

chapters.summary: God tested Abraham by commanding him to offer Isaac as a burnt offering on a mountain in the land of Moriah.
