verses.kjv: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
verses.modern: Then Leah said, 'God has endowed me with a good endowment; now my husband will honor me, because I have borne Him six sons.' So she called His name Zebulun.

verses.kjv: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.modern: Afterward she bore a daughter and called her name Dinah.

verses.kjv: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.modern: Then God remembered Rachel. God listened to her and opened her womb.

verses.kjv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
verses.modern: She conceived and bore a son and said, 'God has taken away my reproach.'

verses.kjv: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
verses.modern: she called His name Joseph, saying, 'May the LORD add to me another son!'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
verses.modern: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, 'Send me away, that I may go to my own home and country.

verses.kjv: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
verses.modern: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go, for you know the service that I have given you.'

verses.kjv: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.
verses.modern: But Laban said to Him, 'If I have found favor in Your sight, please stay, for I have learned by experience that the LORD has blessed me because of You.

verses.kjv: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
verses.modern: Name Your wages. I will give it.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
verses.modern: Jacob said to him, 'You yourself know how I have served you, and how your livestock has fared with me.

verses.kjv: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
verses.modern: For You had little before I came. It has increased abundantly. The LORD has blessed You wherever I turned. But now when shall I provide for my own household also?'

verses.kjv: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock.
verses.modern: He said, 'What shall I give you?' Jacob said, 'You shall not give me anything. If you will do this for me, I will again pasture your flock and keep it.

verses.kjv: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
verses.modern: Let me pass through all your flock today, removing from it every speckled and spotted sheep and every black lamb, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. They shall be my wages.

verses.kjv: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
verses.modern: So my honesty will answer for me later, when you come to look into my wages with you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats and black among the lambs, if found with me, shall be counted stolen.'

verses.kjv: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
verses.modern: Laban said, 'Good! Let it be as you have said.'

verses.kjv: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.modern: But that day Laban removed the male goats that were striped and spotted. All the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white on it, and every black lamb, and put them in the charge of his sons.

verses.kjv: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.
verses.modern: he set a distance of three days' journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob pastured the rest of Laban's flock.

verses.kjv: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.modern: Then Jacob took fresh sticks of poplar and almond and plane trees, and peeled white streaks in them, exposing the white of the sticks.

verses.kjv: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.modern: He set the sticks that he had peeled in front of the flocks in the troughs, that is, the watering places, where the flocks came to drink. And since they bred when they came to drink,

verses.kjv: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.modern: the flocks bred in front of the sticks and so the flocks brought forth striped, speckled, and spotted.

verses.kjv: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.
verses.modern: Jacob separated the lambs and set the faces of the flocks toward the striped and all the black in the flock of Laban. He put his own droves apart and did not put them with Laban's flock.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.modern: Whenever the stronger of the flock were breeding, Jacob would lay the sticks in the troughs before the eyes of the flock, that they might breed among the sticks,

verses.kjv: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.
verses.modern: but for the feebler of the flock he would not lay them there. So the feebler would be Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

verses.kjv: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.modern: Thus the man increased greatly and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

chapters.summary: Rachel, barren and envious of Leah, gave her maid Bilhah to Jacob; Bilhah bore Dan and Naphtali, and Leah's maid Zilpah bore Gad and Asher. Leah bore Issachar, Zebulun, and a daughter Dinah; then God remembered Rachel, and she bore Joseph. Jacob bargained with Laban over wages, breeding the speckled and spotted livestock for himself, and grew exceedingly prosperous.

verses.kjv: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.
verses.modern: Jacob heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, 'Jacob has taken away all that was our father's, and from what was our father's he has gained all this wealth.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
verses.modern: Jacob saw the face of Laban. It was not toward him as before.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
verses.modern: Then the LORD said to Jacob, 'Return to the land of your fathers and to your family. I will be with you.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,
verses.modern: So Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah into the field to his flock

verses.kjv: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.
verses.modern: said to them, 'I see that your father's face is not toward me as before. But the God of my father has been with me.

verses.kjv: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.
verses.modern: You know that I have served your father with all my strength,

verses.kjv: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.
verses.modern: yet your father has cheated me and changed my wages ten times. But God did not permit Him to harm me.

verses.kjv: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.
verses.modern: If he said, The speckled shall be your wages, then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, The striped shall be your wages, then all the flock bore striped.

verses.kjv: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.
verses.modern: Thus God has taken away the livestock of your father and given them to me.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.
verses.modern: In the breeding season of the flock I lifted up my eyes and saw in a dream that the rams leaping on the flock were striped, speckled, and mottled.

verses.kjv: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.
verses.modern: Then the angel of God said to me in the dream, 'Jacob,' and I said, 'Here I am.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
verses.modern: He said, 'Lift up your eyes and see, all the rams leaping on the flock are striped, speckled, and mottled, for I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.

verses.kjv: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.
verses.modern: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and made a vow to me. Now arise, go out from this land and return to the land of your family.'

verses.kjv: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?
verses.modern: Then Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, 'Is there any portion or inheritance left for us in our father's house?

verses.kjv: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
verses.modern: Are we not regarded by him as foreigners? For he has sold us. He has also entirely consumed our money.

verses.kjv: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.
verses.modern: All the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.'

verses.kjv: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;
verses.modern: So Jacob arose and set his sons and his wives on camels,

verses.kjv: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padanaram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
verses.modern: He drove away all his livestock and all his property that he had acquired, the livestock he had gained in Padanaram, to go to the land of Canaan, to his father Isaac.

verses.kjv: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.
verses.modern: Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel stole her father's household gods.

verses.kjv: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
verses.modern: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, by not telling him that he was fleeing.

verses.kjv: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.
verses.modern: So he fled with all that he had. He arose and crossed the Euphrates and set his face toward the hill country of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.
verses.modern: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

verses.kjv: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.
verses.modern: He took his kinsmen with him and pursued Jacob for seven days and overtook him in the hill country of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.modern: But God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night and said to Him, 'Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad.'

verses.kjv: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
verses.modern: Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country, and Laban with his kinsmen pitched tents in the hill country of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
verses.modern: Laban said to Jacob, 'What have you done, that you have deceived me and driven away my daughters like captives taken with the sword?

verses.kjv: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?
verses.modern: Why did you flee secretly and deceive me, and did not tell me, so that I might have sent you away with joy and songs, with tambourine and lyre?

verses.kjv: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.
verses.modern: why did you not permit me to kiss my sons and my daughters farewell? Now you have done foolishly.

verses.kjv: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
verses.modern: It is in my power to do you harm. But the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad.

verses.kjv: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?
verses.modern: now you have gone away because you longed greatly for your father's house, but why did you steal my gods?'

verses.kjv: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.
verses.modern: Jacob answered and said to Laban, 'Because I was afraid, for I thought that you would take your daughters from me by force.

verses.kjv: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.modern: Anyone with whom you find your gods shall not live. In the presence of our kinsmen, point out what I have that is yours, and take it.' Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.

verses.kjv: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.
verses.modern: So Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the tent of the two female servants. But he did not find them. And he went out of Leah's tent and entered Rachel's.

verses.kjv: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
verses.modern: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them in the camel's saddle and sat on them. Laban felt all about the tent but did not find them.

verses.kjv: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
verses.modern: she said to her father, 'Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise before you, for the way of women is upon me.' So he searched but did not find the household gods.

verses.kjv: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?
verses.modern: Then Jacob became angry and argued with Laban. Jacob said to Laban, 'What is my offense? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

verses.kjv: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
verses.modern: For you have felt through all my goods; what have you found of all your household goods? Set it here before my kinsmen and your kinsmen, that they may decide between us two.

verses.kjv: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.
verses.modern: These twenty years I have been with you; your ewes and your female goats have not miscarried. I have not eaten the rams of your flocks.

verses.kjv: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.
verses.modern: What was torn by wild beasts I did not bring to you; I bore the loss of it myself. From my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

verses.kjv: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.
verses.modern: There I was: by day the heat consumed me, and the cold by night, and my sleep fled from my eyes.

verses.kjv: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.
verses.modern: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

verses.kjv: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.
verses.modern: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty-handed. God saw my affliction and the labor of my hands and rebuked you last night.'

verses.kjv: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?
verses.modern: Then Laban answered and said to Jacob, 'The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks. All that you see is mine. But what can I do this day for these my daughters or for their children whom they have borne?

verses.kjv: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.
verses.modern: Come now, let us make a covenant, you and I. And let it be a witness between you and me.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
verses.modern: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.

verses.kjv: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
verses.modern: Jacob said to his kinsmen, 'Gather stones.' And they took stones and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

verses.kjv: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.modern: Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

verses.kjv: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
verses.modern: Laban said, 'This heap is a witness between you and me today.' Therefore he named it Galeed,

verses.kjv: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
verses.modern: also Mizpah, for He said, 'The LORD watch between You and me, when we are out of one another's sight.

verses.kjv: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.
verses.modern: If You mistreat my daughters, or if You take wives besides my daughters, although no one is with us, see, God is witness between You and me.'

verses.kjv: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;
verses.modern: Then Laban said to Jacob, 'See this heap and the pillar, which I have set between you and me.

verses.kjv: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.
verses.modern: This heap is a witness, and the pillar is a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

verses.kjv: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.modern: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.' So Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.

verses.kjv: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.
verses.modern: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice in the hill country and called his kinsmen to eat bread. They ate bread and spent the night in the hill country.

verses.kjv: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.
verses.modern: Early in the morning Laban arose and kissed his sons and his daughters and blessed them. Then Laban departed and returned to his home.

chapters.summary: Jacob fled from Laban with his wives, children, and livestock after God told him to return to his homeland; Rachel secretly stole her father's household gods. Laban pursued and overtook Jacob in the hill country of Gilead, but God warned Laban in a dream not to harm him. They confronted each other, searched the tents without finding the idols, and made a covenant at a heap of stones before parting in peace.

verses.kjv: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.modern: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met Him.

verses.kjv: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.modern: When Jacob saw them, he said, 'This is God's camp!' So He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

verses.kjv: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.modern: Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother in the land of Seir, the country of Edom,

verses.kjv: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:
verses.modern: instructing them, 'Thus you shall say to my lord Esau: Thus says your servant Jacob, I have stayed with Laban and stayed until now.

verses.kjv: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
verses.modern: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, in order to find favor in your sight.'

verses.kjv: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.
verses.modern: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, 'We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and there are four hundred men with him.'

verses.kjv: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;
verses.modern: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed. He divided the people who were with him, and the flocks and herds and camels, into two companies,

verses.kjv: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.
verses.modern: thinking, 'If Esau comes to the one company and attacks it, then the other company that is left will escape.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:
verses.modern: Jacob said, 'O God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, O LORD who said to me, Return to Your country and to Your family, that I may do You good,

verses.kjv: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.
verses.modern: I am not worthy of the least of all the deeds of mercy and all the faithfulness that You have shown to Your servant, for with only my staff I crossed this Jordan, and now I have become two camps.

verses.kjv: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.
verses.modern: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau, for I fear him, that he may come and attack me, the mothers with the children.

verses.kjv: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
verses.modern: But you said, I will surely do you good, and make your seed as the sand of the sea, which shall be too numerous to count.'

verses.kjv: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;
verses.modern: So he stayed there that night, and from what he had with him he took a present for his brother Esau:

verses.kjv: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
verses.modern: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

verses.kjv: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
verses.modern: thirty milk camels and their calves, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.

verses.kjv: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.
verses.modern: These he handed over to his servants, every drove by itself, and said to his servants, 'Pass on ahead of me and put a space between drove and drove.'

verses.kjv: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?
verses.modern: He instructed the first, 'When Esau my brother meets you and asks you, To whom do you belong? Where are you going? And whose are these ahead of you?

verses.kjv: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.
verses.modern: then you shall say, They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a present sent to my lord Esau. And he is also behind us.'

verses.kjv: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.
verses.modern: He likewise instructed the second and the third and all who followed the droves, 'You shall say the same thing to Esau when you meet him,

verses.kjv: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.
verses.modern: you shall say, Moreover, your servant Jacob is behind us.' For he thought, 'I may appease him with the present that goes ahead of me, and afterward I shall see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.'

verses.kjv: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.
verses.modern: So the present passed on ahead of him. He himself stayed that night in the camp.

verses.kjv: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.
verses.modern: That same night he arose and took his two wives, his two female servants, and his eleven children, and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.

verses.kjv: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.
verses.modern: He took them and sent them across the stream, and everything else that he had.

verses.kjv: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.modern: Jacob was left alone. And a man wrestled with him until the breaking of the day.

verses.kjv: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
verses.modern: When the man saw that he did not prevail against Jacob, he touched the socket of his thigh, and the socket of Jacob's thigh was put out of joint as he wrestled with him.

verses.kjv: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
verses.modern: Then he said, 'Let me go, for the day has broken.' But Jacob said, 'I will not let you go unless you bless me.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.
verses.modern: He said to him, 'What is your name?' And he said, 'Jacob.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
verses.modern: Then he said, 'Your name shall no more be called Jacob, but Israel; for as a prince you have power with God and with men, and have prevailed.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.
verses.modern: Then Jacob asked him, 'Please tell me your name.' But he said, 'Why is it that you ask my name?' And there he blessed him.

verses.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
verses.modern: So Jacob called the name of the place Peniel, saying, 'For I have seen God face to face, and yet my life has been delivered.'

verses.kjv: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.
verses.modern: The sun rose upon him as he passed Penuel, limping because of his thigh.

verses.kjv: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
verses.modern: Therefore to this day the children of Israel do not eat the sinew of the thigh that is on the hip socket, because he touched the socket of Jacob's thigh on the sinew of the thigh.

chapters.summary: Jacob sent messengers ahead to Esau and learned that Esau was coming to meet him with 400 men; fearful, he divided his company in two and prayed for deliverance. He sent droves of livestock ahead as gifts to appease Esau. That night Jacob wrestled a man until dawn at the ford of the Jabbok; the man touched his hip and dislocated it, but blessed him and renamed him Israel.

verses.kjv: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.
verses.modern: Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and Esau was coming, and four hundred men with him. So he divided the children among Leah and Rachel and the two female servants.

verses.kjv: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
verses.modern: He put the female servants with their children in front, then Leah with her children, and Rachel and Joseph last of all.

verses.kjv: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.modern: He himself went on before them, bowing himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

verses.kjv: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
verses.modern: But Esau ran to meet him and embraced him and fell on his neck and kissed him. They wept.

verses.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.
verses.modern: When Esau lifted up his eyes and saw the women and children, he said, 'Who are these with you?' Jacob said, 'The children whom God has graciously given your servant.'

verses.kjv: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
verses.modern: Then the female servants drew near, they and their children, and bowed down.

verses.kjv: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
verses.modern: Leah likewise and her children drew near and bowed down. And last Joseph and Rachel drew near. They bowed down.

verses.kjv: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.modern: Esau said, 'What do you mean by all this company that I met?' Jacob answered, 'To find favor in the sight of my lord.'

verses.kjv: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.
verses.modern: But Esau said, 'I have enough, my brother; keep what you have for yourself.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
verses.modern: Jacob said, 'No, please, if I have found favor in your sight, then accept my present from my hand. For I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you have accepted me.

verses.kjv: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.
verses.modern: Please accept my gift that is brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.' Thus He urged Him. He took it.

verses.kjv: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
verses.modern: Then Esau said, 'Let us journey on our way. I will go ahead of you.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.
verses.modern: But Jacob said to him, 'My lord knows that the children are frail, and that the nursing flocks and herds are a care to me. If they are driven hard for one day, all the flocks will die.

verses.kjv: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.
verses.modern: Let my lord pass on ahead of his servant. I will lead on slowly, at the pace of the livestock that are ahead of me and at the pace of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir.'

verses.kjv: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.
verses.modern: So Esau said, 'Let me leave with you some of the people who are with me.' But he said, 'What need is there? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.'

verses.kjv: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
verses.modern: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

verses.kjv: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.modern: But Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built himself a house, and made booths for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

verses.kjv: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padanaram; and pitched his tent before the city.
verses.modern: Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, on his way from Padanaram. He camped before the city.

verses.kjv: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.
verses.modern: from the sons of Hamor, Shechem's father, he bought for a hundred pieces of money the piece of land on which he had pitched his tent.

verses.kjv: And he erected there an altar, and called it Elelohe-Israel.
verses.modern: There He erected an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.

chapters.summary: Esau ran to meet Jacob and they embraced and wept, reconciling after years of separation. Jacob urged Esau to accept his gifts and Esau returned to Seir, while Jacob journeyed to Succoth and then to Shechem in Canaan. There Jacob bought a parcel of land, set up an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.

verses.kjv: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.modern: Now Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the women of the land.

verses.kjv: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.
verses.modern: When Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her, he seized her and lay with her and humiliated her.

verses.kjv: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.
verses.modern: His soul was drawn to Dinah the daughter of Jacob. He loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.

verses.kjv: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.
verses.modern: So Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, 'Get me this girl for my wife.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.
verses.modern: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled his daughter Dinah. But his sons were with his livestock in the field, so Jacob held his peace until they came.

verses.kjv: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.
verses.modern: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.
verses.modern: The sons of Jacob came in from the field as soon as they heard of it, and the men were grieved and very angry, because he had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter, for such a thing must not be done.

verses.kjv: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.
verses.modern: But Hamor spoke with them, saying, 'The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him to be his wife.

verses.kjv: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.
verses.modern: Make marriages with us: give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

verses.kjv: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
verses.modern: You shall dwell with us, and the land shall be open to you. Dwell and trade in it, and get property in it.'

verses.kjv: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.
verses.modern: Shechem also said to her father and to her brothers, 'Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you say to me I will give.

verses.kjv: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.
verses.modern: Ask me for as great a bride-price and gift as you will. I will give whatever you say to me. Only give me the young woman to be my wife.'

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:
verses.modern: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and his father Hamor deceitfully, because he had defiled their sister Dinah.

verses.kjv: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
verses.modern: They said to them, 'We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised, for that would be a disgrace to us.

verses.kjv: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;
verses.modern: Only on this condition will we agree with you — that you will become as we are, and every male among you be circumcised.

verses.kjv: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.modern: Then we will give our daughters to you. We will take your daughters for ourselves. We will dwell with you and become one people.

verses.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.
verses.modern: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and go.'

verses.kjv: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.
verses.modern: Their words pleased Hamor and Hamor's son Shechem.

verses.kjv: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.
verses.modern: The young man did not delay to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter. Now he was the most honored of all his father's house.

verses.kjv: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,
verses.modern: So Hamor and his son Shechem came to the gate of their city and spoke to the men of their city, saying,

verses.kjv: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.modern: 'These men are at peace with us; let them dwell in the land and trade in it, for the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters as wives, and let us give them our daughters.

verses.kjv: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
verses.modern: Only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us to become one people — when every male among us is circumcised as they are circumcised.

verses.kjv: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.
verses.modern: Will not their livestock, their property, and all their beasts be ours? Only let us agree with them, and they will dwell with us.'

verses.kjv: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.
verses.modern: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.
verses.modern: On the third day, when they were sore, two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, took their swords and came against the city while it felt secure, and killed all the males.

verses.kjv: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.
verses.modern: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with the edge of the sword and took Dinah out of Shechem's house and went away.

verses.kjv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.modern: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

verses.kjv: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,
verses.modern: They took their flocks and their herds and their donkeys, and whatever was in the city and in the field.

verses.kjv: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.
verses.modern: All their wealth and all their little ones and all their wives they took captive, and they plundered all that was in the houses.

verses.kjv: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
verses.modern: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, 'You have brought trouble on me by making me stink among the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites and the Perizzites. My numbers are few, and if they gather themselves against me and attack me, I shall be destroyed, both I and my household.'

verses.kjv: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?
verses.modern: But they said, 'Should he treat our sister like a prostitute?'

chapters.summary: Shechem the son of Hamor seized Dinah and violated her, then sought to marry her. Jacob's sons answered deceitfully, demanding that all the men of the city be circumcised as a condition; while the men were still in pain, Simeon and Levi killed every male in the city and took Dinah back. Jacob rebuked them for making him odious among the Canaanites.

verses.kjv: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.
verses.modern: God said to Jacob, 'Arise, go up to Bethel and dwell there. Make an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.'

verses.kjv: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:
verses.modern: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, 'Put away the foreign gods that are among you and purify yourselves and change your garments.

verses.kjv: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
verses.modern: Then let us arise and go up to Bethel, so that I may make there an altar to the God Who answered me in the day of my distress and has been with me wherever I have gone.'

verses.kjv: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
verses.modern: So they gave to Jacob all the foreign gods that they had, and the rings that were in their ears. Jacob hid them under the oak that was near Shechem.

verses.kjv: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.
verses.modern: As they journeyed, a terror from God fell upon the cities that were around them, so that they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.

verses.kjv: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
verses.modern: Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

verses.kjv: And he built there an altar, and called the place Elbethel: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.modern: There he built an altar and called the place El-bethel, because there God had revealed himself to him when He fled from His brother.

verses.kjv: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allonbachuth.
verses.modern: Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died. She was buried under an oak below Bethel. So he called its name Allon-bacuth.

verses.kjv: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padanaram, and blessed him.
verses.modern: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Padanaram, and blessed him.

verses.kjv: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.
verses.modern: God said to Him, 'Your name is Jacob; no longer shall your name be called Jacob. But Israel shall be your name.' So he called his name Israel.

verses.kjv: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;
verses.modern: God said to Him, 'I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations shall come from you, and kings shall come from your own body.

verses.kjv: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
verses.modern: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you. I will give the land to your seed after you.'

verses.kjv: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
verses.modern: Then God went up from Him in the place where He had spoken with Him.

verses.kjv: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.
verses.modern: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he had spoken with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it and poured oil on it.

verses.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
verses.modern: So Jacob called the name of the place where God had spoken with him, Bethel.

verses.kjv: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.
verses.modern: Then they journeyed from Bethel. When they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel went into labor. She had hard labor.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
verses.modern: when her labor was at its hardest, the midwife said to her, 'Do not fear, for you have another son.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Benoni: but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.modern: as her soul was departing (for she was dying), she called his name Ben-oni; but his father called him Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
verses.modern: So Rachel died. She was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).

verses.kjv: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.
verses.modern: Jacob set up a pillar over her tomb. It is the pillar of Rachel's tomb, which is there to this day.

verses.kjv: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
verses.modern: Israel journeyed on and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.modern: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine. Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

verses.kjv: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:
verses.modern: The sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

verses.kjv: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:
verses.modern: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
verses.modern: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel's servant: Dan and Naphtali.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padanaram.
verses.modern: The sons of Zilpah, Leah's servant: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Padanaram.

verses.kjv: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
verses.modern: Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, or Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.

verses.kjv: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
verses.modern: Now the days of Isaac were 180 years.

verses.kjv: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.modern: Isaac breathed his last. He died and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. His sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

chapters.summary: God told Jacob to go to Bethel; Jacob put away his household's foreign gods and built an altar there, and God appeared again, confirming his name as Israel and renewing the covenant promises. Rachel died giving birth to Benjamin on the road to Ephrath and was buried there. Isaac died at 180 in Hebron, and Esau and Jacob buried him.

verses.kjv: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
verses.modern: These are the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

verses.kjv: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.modern: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

verses.kjv: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
verses.modern: Bashemath, Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebajoth.

verses.kjv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
verses.modern: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz, and Bashemath bore Reuel,

verses.kjv: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.modern: Aholibamah bore Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
verses.modern: Then Esau took his wives, his sons and his daughters and all the members of his household, his livestock, all his beasts, and all his property that he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

verses.kjv: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.modern: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their sojournings could not support them because of their livestock.

verses.kjv: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
verses.modern: So Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. (Esau is Edom.)

verses.kjv: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
verses.modern: These are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.

verses.kjv: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
verses.modern: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.modern: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

verses.kjv: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
verses.modern: Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son; she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the sons of Bashemath, Esau's wife.

verses.kjv: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.

verses.kjv: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
verses.modern: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zepho, Chief Kenaz,

verses.kjv: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
verses.modern: Chief Korah, Chief Gatam, and Chief Amalek. These are the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, Chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath, Esau's wife.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Aholibamah, Esau's wife: Chief Jeush, Chief Jaalam, Chief Korah. These are the chiefs descended from Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
verses.modern: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.kjv: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.modern: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.

verses.kjv: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
verses.modern: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Lotan's sister was Timna.

verses.kjv: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

verses.kjv: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who found the mules in the wilderness as he pastured the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

verses.kjv: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.modern: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

verses.kjv: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.kjv: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

verses.kjv: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

verses.kjv: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
verses.modern: These are the chiefs of the Horites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,

verses.kjv: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
verses.modern: Chief Dishon, Chief Ezer, Chief Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites, chief by chief in the land of Seir.

verses.kjv: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.modern: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.modern: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

verses.kjv: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.modern: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Avith.

verses.kjv: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.modern: Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

verses.kjv: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.modern: Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place, and the name of his city was Pau; his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.

verses.kjv: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
verses.modern: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their clans and their dwelling places, by their names: Chief Timna, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,

verses.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.modern: Chief Aholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,

verses.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.modern: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,

verses.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
verses.modern: Chief Magdiel, Chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom by their dwelling places in the land of their possession. This is Esau the father of the Edomites.

chapters.summary: The descendants of Esau (that is, Edom) are listed — his wives, sons, and the chiefs and kings who ruled in the land of Edom before any king reigned in Israel. Esau settled in the hill country of Seir because the land could not support both him and Jacob together.

verses.kjv: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
verses.modern: Jacob lived in the land of his father's sojournings, in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
verses.modern: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was pasturing the flock with his brothers. He was a young man with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives. And Joseph brought a bad report of them to their father.

verses.kjv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.
verses.modern: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons, because he was the son of his old age. And he made him a coat of many colors.

verses.kjv: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
verses.modern: But when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him and could not speak peaceably to him.

verses.kjv: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
verses.modern: Now Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers they hated him even more.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.modern: He said to them, 'Hear this dream that I have dreamed:

verses.kjv: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
verses.modern: we were binding sheaves in the field, and my sheaf arose and stood upright. And your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to my sheaf.'

verses.kjv: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
verses.modern: His brothers said to him, 'Are you indeed to reign over us? Are you indeed to rule over us?' So they hated him even more for his dreams and for his words.

verses.kjv: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
verses.modern: Then he dreamed another dream and told it to his brothers and said, ' I have dreamed another dream. The sun, the moon, and eleven stars were bowing down to me.'

verses.kjv: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
verses.modern: But when he told it to his father and to his brothers, his father rebuked him and said to him, 'What is this dream that you have dreamed? Shall I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves to the ground before you?'

verses.kjv: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
verses.modern: his brothers were jealous of him. But his father kept the saying in mind.

verses.kjv: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
verses.modern: Now his brothers went to pasture their father's flock near Shechem.

verses.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.
verses.modern: Israel said to Joseph, 'Are not your brothers pasturing the flock at Shechem? Come, I will send you to them.' And he said to him, 'Here I am.'

verses.kjv: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.modern: So he said to him, 'Go now, see if it is well with your brothers and with the flock, and bring me word again.' So he sent him from the Valley of Hebron. He came to Shechem.

verses.kjv: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
verses.modern: A man found him wandering in the fields. The man asked him, 'What are you seeking?'

verses.kjv: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.
verses.modern: 'I am seeking my brothers,' he said.' Tell me, please, where they are pasturing the flock.'

verses.kjv: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
verses.modern: The man said, 'They have gone away, for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan.' So Joseph went after his brothers and found them at Dothan.

verses.kjv: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
verses.modern: They saw him from afar, and before he came near to them they conspired against him to kill him.

verses.kjv: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
verses.modern: They said to one another, 'Here comes this dreamer.

verses.kjv: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
verses.modern: Come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits. Then we will say that a fierce animal has devoured him. We will see what will become of his dreams.'

verses.kjv: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
verses.modern: But when Reuben heard it, he rescued him out of their hands, saying, 'Let us not take his life.'

verses.kjv: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
verses.modern: Reuben said to them, 'Shed no blood; cast him into this pit here in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him,' that he might rescue him out of their hands to restore him to his father.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;
verses.modern: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his coat, the coat of many colors that he wore.

verses.kjv: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.
verses.modern: they took him and cast him into a pit. The pit was empty; there was no water in it.

verses.kjv: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.modern: Then they sat down to eat. And looking up they saw a caravan of Ishmeelites coming from Gilead with their camels bearing gum, balm, and myrrh, on their way to carry it down to Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
verses.modern: Then Judah said to his brothers, 'What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

verses.kjv: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.
verses.modern: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him, for he is our brother, our own flesh.' And his brothers listened to him.

verses.kjv: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.modern: Then Midianite traders passed by. And they drew Joseph up and lifted him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver. They took Joseph to Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
verses.modern: When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not in the pit, he tore his clothes.

verses.kjv: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?
verses.modern: he He returned to his brothers and said, 'The boy is gone. I, where shall I go?'

verses.kjv: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
verses.modern: Then they took Joseph's coat and slaughtered a young goat and dipped the coat in the blood.

verses.kjv: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.
verses.modern: They sent the coat of many colors and brought it to their father and said, 'This we have found; please identify whether it is your son's coat or not.'

verses.kjv: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
verses.modern: He identified it and said, 'It is my son's coat. A fierce animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn to pieces.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.modern: Then Jacob tore his garments and put sackcloth on his loins and mourned for his son many days.

verses.kjv: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
verses.modern: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him. But he refused to be comforted and said, 'No, I shall go down to the grave to my son, mourning.' Thus his father wept for him.

verses.kjv: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.
verses.modern: Meanwhile the Midianites had sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the guard.

chapters.summary: Jacob loved Joseph above all his sons and made him a coat of many colors, which provoked his brothers' hatred; Joseph's dreams of his family bowing down to him deepened their resentment. His brothers conspired to kill him but instead sold him to Midianite merchants for twenty pieces of silver; the merchants took Joseph to Egypt and sold him to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh. The brothers dipped Joseph's coat in goat's blood and deceived Jacob into believing his son was dead.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.modern: At that time Judah went down from his brothers and turned aside to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

verses.kjv: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.
verses.modern: There Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shuah. He took her and went in to her,

verses.kjv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.
verses.modern: she conceived and bore a son. He called His name Er.

verses.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.
verses.modern: She conceived again and bore a son. She called His name Onan.

verses.kjv: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.
verses.modern: Yet again she bore a son. She called His name Shelah. Judah was in Chezib when she bore Him.

verses.kjv: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.
verses.modern: Judah took a wife for Er His firstborn. Her name was Tamar.

verses.kjv: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.
verses.modern: But Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD. The LORD put Him to death.

verses.kjv: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.
verses.modern: Then Judah said to Onan, 'Go in to Your brother's wife and perform the duty of a brother-in-law to her, and raise up seed for Your brother.'

verses.kjv: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.
verses.modern: But Onan knew that the seed would not be His. So whenever He went in to His brother's wife He would waste the semen on the ground, so as not to give seed to His brother.

verses.kjv: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.
verses.modern: What He did was displeasing in the sight of the LORD. He put Him to death also.

verses.kjv: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.
verses.modern: Then Judah said to Tamar His daughter-in-law, 'Remain a widow in Your father's house, till Shelah my son grows up,' for He feared that He would die, like His brothers. So Tamar went and remained in her father's house.
