verses.kjv: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.modern: In the course of time the wife of Judah, Shua's daughter, died. When Judah was comforted, He went up to Timnath to His sheepshearers, He and His friend Hirah the Adullamite.

verses.kjv: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
verses.modern: When Tamar was told, 'Your father-in-law is going up to Timnath to shear his sheep,'

verses.kjv: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.
verses.modern: she took off her widow's garments and covered herself with a veil, wrapping herself up, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath. For she saw that Shelah was grown up. She had not been given to Him in marriage.

verses.kjv: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.
verses.modern: When Judah saw her, He thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

verses.kjv: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
verses.modern: He turned to her at the roadside and said, 'Come, let me come in to You,' for He did not know that she was His daughter-in-law. She said, 'What will You give me, that You may come in to me?'

verses.kjv: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
verses.modern: He answered, 'I will send You a young goat from the flock.' And she said, 'Will You give me a pledge, until You send it?'

verses.kjv: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
verses.modern: He said, 'What pledge shall I give You?' She replied, 'Your signet and Your cord and Your staff that is in Your hand.' So He gave them to her and went in to her. She conceived by Him.

verses.kjv: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.modern: Then she arose and went away, and taking off her veil she put on the garments of her widowhood.

verses.kjv: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.
verses.modern: When Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite to take back the pledge from the woman's hand, he did not find her.

verses.kjv: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.
verses.modern: he asked the men of the place, 'Where is the harlot that was openly by the way side?' And they said, 'No harlot has been here.'

verses.kjv: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.
verses.modern: So he returned to Judah and said, 'I have not found her. Also, the men of the place said, No harlot has been here.'

verses.kjv: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.
verses.modern: Judah said, 'Let her keep the things as her own, or we shall be laughed at. You see, I sent this young goat, and you did not find her.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.
verses.modern: About three months later Judah was told, 'Tamar your daughter-in-law has been immoral. Moreover, she is pregnant by immorality.' And Judah said, 'Bring her out, and let her be burned.'

verses.kjv: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.
verses.modern: As she was being brought out, she sent word to her father-in-law, 'By the man to whom these belong, I am with child.' And she said, 'Please identify whose these are, the signet and the cord and the staff.'

verses.kjv: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
verses.modern: Then Judah identified them and said, 'She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah.' And he did not know her again.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.modern: When the time of her labor came, there were twins in her womb.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.
verses.modern: When she was in labor, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, 'This one came out first.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.
verses.modern: But as He drew back His hand, His brother came out. And she said, 'What a breach You have made for Yourself!' Therefore His name was called Pharez.

verses.kjv: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
verses.modern: Afterward His brother came out with the scarlet thread on His hand. His name was called Zarah.

chapters.summary: Judah married a Canaanite woman and had three sons; his firstborn Er died for his wickedness, and Onan was also slain for refusing to raise up seed for his brother. Judah withheld his third son Shelah from Tamar, so she disguised herself, lay with Judah by the roadside, and conceived twins. When Judah learned the truth he declared her more righteous than himself; she bore Pharez and Zarah.

verses.kjv: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.
verses.modern: Now Joseph had been brought down to Egypt, and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, had bought him from the Ishmeelites who had brought him down there.

verses.kjv: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verses.modern: The LORD was with Joseph. He became a successful man. He was in the house of His Egyptian master.

verses.kjv: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
verses.modern: His master saw that the LORD was with Him and that the LORD caused all that He did to succeed in His hand.

verses.kjv: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
verses.modern: So Joseph found favor in his sight and attended him. He made him overseer of his house and put him in charge of all that he had.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.
verses.modern: From the time that He made Him overseer in His house and over all that He had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake, and the blessing of the LORD was on all that He had, in house and field.

verses.kjv: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.
verses.modern: So he left all that he had in Joseph's charge, and because of him he had no concern about anything but the food he ate. Now Joseph was handsome in form and appearance.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
verses.modern: After a time his master's wife cast her eyes on Joseph and said, 'Lie with me.'

verses.kjv: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;
verses.modern: But he refused and said to his master's wife, ' because of me my master has no concern about anything in the house. He has put everything that he has in my charge.

verses.kjv: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?
verses.modern: He is not greater in this house than I am, nor has he kept back anything from me except you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness and sin against God?'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
verses.modern: As she spoke to Joseph day after day, he would not listen to her, to lie beside her or to be with her.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.
verses.modern: But one day, when he went into the house to do his work and none of the men of the house was there in the house,

verses.kjv: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.
verses.modern: she caught him by his garment, saying, 'Lie with me.' But he left his garment in her hand and fled and got out of the house.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,
verses.modern: As soon as she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and had fled out of the house,

verses.kjv: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:
verses.modern: she called to the men of her house and said to them, 'See, he has brought among us a Hebrew to laugh at us. He came in to me to lie with me. I cried out with a loud voice.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
verses.modern: when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried out, he left his garment beside me and fled and got out of the house.'

verses.kjv: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.
verses.modern: Then she laid up his garment by her until his master came home,

verses.kjv: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:
verses.modern: She told him the same story, saying, 'The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought among us, came in to me to laugh at me.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
verses.modern: But as soon as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment beside me and fled out of the house.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.
verses.modern: As soon as his master heard the words that his wife spoke to him, 'This is the way your servant treated me,' his anger was kindled.

verses.kjv: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
verses.modern: Joseph's master took him and put him into the prison, the place where the king's prisoners were confined. He was there in prison.

verses.kjv: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.modern: But the LORD was with Joseph and showed him mercy and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

verses.kjv: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.
verses.modern: The keeper of the prison put Joseph in charge of all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever was done there, he was the one who did it.

verses.kjv: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.
verses.modern: The keeper of the prison paid no attention to anything that was in Joseph's charge, because the LORD was with Him. And whatever He did, the LORD made it succeed.

chapters.summary: Joseph prospered in Potiphar's house because the LORD was with him, and Potiphar put him in charge of everything he owned. Potiphar's wife repeatedly tried to seduce Joseph; when he refused and fled, she falsely accused him. Potiphar cast Joseph into prison, but the LORD was with him there, and the keeper of the prison put everything in Joseph's charge.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.
verses.modern: Some time after this, the cupbearer of the king of Egypt and his baker committed an offense against their lord the king of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.
verses.modern: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,

verses.kjv: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
verses.modern: he put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the prison where Joseph was confined.

verses.kjv: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.
verses.modern: The captain of the guard appointed Joseph to be with them. He attended them. They continued for some time in custody.

verses.kjv: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.
verses.modern: One night they both dreamed, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were confined in the prison—each his own dream, and each dream with its own interpretation.

verses.kjv: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.
verses.modern: When Joseph came to them in the morning, he saw that they were troubled.

verses.kjv: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?
verses.modern: So he asked Pharaoh's officers who were with him in custody in his master's house, 'Why are your faces downcast today?'

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
verses.modern: They said to him, 'We have had dreams, and there is no one to interpret them.' And Joseph said to them, 'Do not interpretations belong to God? Please tell them to me.'

verses.kjv: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;
verses.modern: So the chief cupbearer told his dream to Joseph and said to him, 'In my dream there was a vine before me,

verses.kjv: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:
verses.modern: on the vine there were three branches. As soon as it budded, its blossoms shot forth, and the clusters ripened into grapes.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
verses.modern: Pharaoh's cup was in my hand. I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup and placed the cup in Pharaoh's hand.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:
verses.modern: Then Joseph said to him, 'This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

verses.kjv: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.
verses.modern: In three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your office, and you shall place Pharaoh's cup in his hand as formerly, when you were his cupbearer.

verses.kjv: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:
verses.modern: Only remember me, when it is well with you, and please do me the kindness to mention me to Pharaoh, and so get me out of this house.

verses.kjv: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.
verses.modern: For I was indeed stolen out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the pit.'

verses.kjv: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:
verses.modern: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was favorable, he said to Joseph, 'I also had a dream: there were three cake baskets on my head,

verses.kjv: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.
verses.modern: in the uppermost basket there were all sorts of baked food for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating it out of the basket on my head.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:
verses.modern: Joseph answered and said, 'This is its interpretation: the three baskets are three days.

verses.kjv: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.
verses.modern: In three days Pharaoh will lift up your head—from you!—and hang you on a tree. And the birds will eat the flesh from you.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.
verses.modern: On the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, he made a feast for all his servants and lifted up the head of the chief cupbearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

verses.kjv: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:
verses.modern: He restored the chief cupbearer to his position. He placed the cup in Pharaoh's hand.

verses.kjv: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.modern: But he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

verses.kjv: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.
verses.modern: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.

chapters.summary: Pharaoh's chief cupbearer and chief baker were imprisoned with Joseph, and each had a dream the same night. Joseph interpreted the cupbearer's dream as restoration to his post in three days, and the baker's as execution in three days — both came to pass exactly as Joseph said. The cupbearer forgot Joseph and did not mention him to Pharaoh.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.
verses.modern: After two whole years, Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing by the Nile,

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
verses.modern: There came up out of the Nile seven cows, attractive and plump. They fed in the reed grass.

verses.kjv: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.
verses.modern: Seven other cows, ugly and thin, came up out of the Nile after them and stood by the other cows on the bank of the Nile.

verses.kjv: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.modern: The ugly, thin cows ate up the seven attractive, plump cows. And Pharaoh awoke.

verses.kjv: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.
verses.modern: He fell asleep and dreamed a second time. And seven ears of grain, plump and good, were growing on one stalk.

verses.kjv: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
verses.modern: After them sprouted seven ears, thin and blighted by the east wind.

verses.kjv: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
verses.modern: The thin ears swallowed up the seven plump, full ears. And Pharaoh awoke. It was a dream.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.
verses.modern: So in the morning his spirit was troubled. He sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt and all its wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was none who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

verses.kjv: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:
verses.modern: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, 'I remember my offenses today.

verses.kjv: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:
verses.modern: When Pharaoh was angry with his servants and put me and the chief baker in custody in the house of the captain of the guard,

verses.kjv: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.modern: we dreamed on the same night, he and I, each having a dream with its own interpretation.

verses.kjv: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.
verses.modern: A young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. When we told him, he interpreted our dreams to us, giving to each man an interpretation.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.
verses.modern: as he interpreted to us, so it came to pass; I was restored to my office, and the baker was hanged.'

verses.kjv: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.
verses.modern: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph. They quickly brought him out of the pit. And when he had shaved himself and changed his clothes, he came in before Pharaoh.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.
verses.modern: Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'I have had a dream, and there is no one to interpret it. I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.
verses.modern: Joseph answered Pharaoh, 'It is not in me; God will give Pharaoh a favorable answer.'

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:
verses.modern: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, ' in my dream I was standing on the banks of the Nile.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:
verses.modern: Seven cows, plump and attractive, came up out of the Nile and fed in the reed grass.

verses.kjv: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:
verses.modern: Seven other cows came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I had never seen in all the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
verses.modern: The thin, ugly cows ate up the first seven plump cows,

verses.kjv: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.modern: but when they had eaten them no one would have known that they had eaten them, for they were still as ugly as at the beginning. Then I awoke.

verses.kjv: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
verses.modern: I also saw in my dream seven ears growing on one stalk, full and good.

verses.kjv: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
verses.modern: Seven ears, withered, thin, and blighted by the east wind, sprouted after them,

verses.kjv: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.
verses.modern: The thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears. And I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.modern: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, 'The dreams of Pharaoh are one; God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

verses.kjv: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.
verses.modern: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good ears are seven years; the dreams are one.

verses.kjv: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
verses.modern: The seven lean and ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, and the seven empty ears blighted by the east wind are also seven years of famine.

verses.kjv: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
verses.modern: It is as I told Pharaoh: God has shown to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

verses.kjv: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
verses.modern: There will come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt,

verses.kjv: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
verses.modern: but after them there will arise seven years of famine. All the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

verses.kjv: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.
verses.modern: the plenty will be unknown in the land because of the famine that follows, for it will be very severe.

verses.kjv: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.modern: the doubling of Pharaoh's dream means that the thing is fixed by God. God will shortly bring it about.

verses.kjv: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: Now therefore let Pharaoh select a discerning and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
verses.modern: Let Pharaoh proceed to appoint overseers over the land and take one-fifth of the produce of the land of Egypt during the seven plentiful years.

verses.kjv: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
verses.modern: let them gather all the food of these good years that are coming and store up grain under the authority of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

verses.kjv: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
verses.modern: That food shall be a reserve for the land against the seven years of famine that are to occur in the land of Egypt, so that the land may not perish through the famine.'

verses.kjv: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.modern: This proposal pleased Pharaoh and all his servants.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?
verses.modern: Pharaoh said to his servants, 'Can we find a man like this, in whom is the Spirit of God?'

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:
verses.modern: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'Since God has shown you all this, there is none so discerning and wise as you are.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
verses.modern: You shall be over my house. All my people shall order themselves as you command. Only as regards the throne will I be greater than you.'

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
verses.modern: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring from his hand and put it on Joseph's hand, and clothed him in garments of fine linen and put a gold chain about his neck.

verses.kjv: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: he made him ride in his second chariot. And they called out before him, 'Bow the knee!' Thus he set him over all the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: Moreover, Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'I am Pharaoh, and without your consent no one shall lift up hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah. And he gave him in marriage Asenath, the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. So Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh and went through all the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
verses.modern: During the seven plentiful years the earth produced abundantly,

verses.kjv: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.
verses.modern: He gathered up all the food of these seven years, which occurred in the land of Egypt, and put the food in the cities. He put in every city the food from the fields around it.

verses.kjv: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
verses.modern: Joseph stored up grain in great abundance, like the sand of the sea, until he ceased to measure it, for it could not be measured.

verses.kjv: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.modern: Before the year of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph. Asenath, the daughter of Potipherah priest of On, bore them to him.

verses.kjv: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
verses.modern: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, 'For,' he said, 'God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father's house.'

verses.kjv: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
verses.modern: The name of the second he called Ephraim, 'For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.'

verses.kjv: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
verses.modern: The seven years of plenty that occurred in the land of Egypt came to an end,

verses.kjv: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.modern: The seven years of famine began to come, as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

verses.kjv: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
verses.modern: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, 'Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.'

verses.kjv: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: So when the famine had spread over all the land, Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.
verses.modern: Moreover, all the earth came to Egypt to Joseph to buy grain, because the famine was severe over all the earth.

chapters.summary: Two years later Pharaoh dreamed of seven fat cows devoured by seven thin cows and seven plump ears of grain swallowed by seven thin ears; none of his wise men could interpret the dreams. The cupbearer finally remembered Joseph, who was brought from prison and told Pharaoh the dreams meant seven years of plenty followed by seven years of famine. Pharaoh set Joseph over all Egypt to store grain during the years of abundance.

verses.kjv: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
verses.modern: When Jacob learned that there was grain for sale in Egypt, he said to his sons, 'Why do you look at one another?'

verses.kjv: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
verses.modern: He said, 'I have heard that there is grain for sale in Egypt. Go down and buy grain for us there, that we may live and not die.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
verses.modern: So ten of Joseph's brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.

verses.kjv: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
verses.modern: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, with his brothers, for he feared that harm might happen to him.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.modern: Thus the sons of Israel came to buy among the others who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.
verses.modern: Now Joseph was governor over the land. He was the one who sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph's brothers came and bowed themselves before him with their faces to the ground.

verses.kjv: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
verses.modern: Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them. But he treated them like strangers and spoke roughly to them.' Where do you come from?' he said. They said, 'From the land of Canaan, to buy food.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
verses.modern: Joseph recognized his brothers. But they did not recognize him.

verses.kjv: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.modern: Joseph remembered the dreams that he had dreamed of them. And he said to them, 'You are spies; you have come to see the nakedness of the land.'

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
verses.modern: They said to him, 'No, my lord, your servants have come to buy food.

verses.kjv: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
verses.modern: We are all sons of one man. We are honest men. Your servants have never been spies.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.modern: He said to them, 'No, it is the nakedness of the land that you have come to see.'

verses.kjv: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.
verses.modern: They said, 'We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan, and the youngest is this day with our father, and one is no more.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:
verses.modern: But Joseph said to them, 'It is as I said to you. You are spies.

verses.kjv: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
verses.modern: By this you shall be tested: by the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go from this place unless your youngest brother comes here.

verses.kjv: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
verses.modern: Send one of you, and let him bring your brother, while you remain confined, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you. Or else, by the life of Pharaoh, surely you are spies.'

verses.kjv: And he put them all together into ward three days.
verses.modern: He put them all together in custody for three days.

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:
verses.modern: On the third day Joseph said to them, 'Do this and you will live, for I fear God.

verses.kjv: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
verses.modern: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers remain confined where you are in custody, and let the rest go and carry grain for the famine of your households,

verses.kjv: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
verses.modern: bring your youngest brother to me. So your words will be verified, and you shall not die.' And they did so.

verses.kjv: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
verses.modern: Then they said to one another, 'In truth we are guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul when he begged us and we did not listen. That is why this distress has come upon us.'

verses.kjv: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
verses.modern: Reuben answered them, 'Did I not tell you not to sin against the boy? But you did not listen. So now there comes a reckoning for his blood.'

verses.kjv: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
verses.modern: They did not know that Joseph understood them, for there was an interpreter between them.

verses.kjv: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
verses.modern: Then he turned away from them and wept. And he returned to them and spoke to them. And he took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.

verses.kjv: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.
verses.modern: Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, and to replace every man's money in his sack, and to give them provisions for the journey. This was done for them.

verses.kjv: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
verses.modern: Then they loaded their donkeys with their grain and departed.

verses.kjv: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.
verses.modern: as one of them opened his sack to give his donkey fodder at the lodging place, he saw his money in the mouth of his sack.

verses.kjv: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?
verses.modern: He said to his brothers, 'My money has been put back; here it is in the mouth of my sack!' At this their hearts failed them. They turned trembling to one another, saying, 'What is this that God has done to us?'

verses.kjv: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
verses.modern: When they came to Jacob their father in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them, saying,

verses.kjv: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.modern: 'The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly to us and took us to be spies of the land.

verses.kjv: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
verses.modern: But we said to him, We are honest men; we have never been spies.

verses.kjv: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
verses.modern: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father. One is no more, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

verses.kjv: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
verses.modern: Then the man, the lord of the land, said to us, By this I shall know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your households and go your way.

verses.kjv: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
verses.modern: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I shall know that you are not spies but honest men. I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.modern: As they emptied their sacks, every man's bundle of money was in his sack. And when they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

verses.kjv: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.
verses.modern: Jacob their father said to them, 'You have bereaved me of my children: Joseph is no more, and Simeon is no more, and now you would take Benjamin. All this has come against me.'

verses.kjv: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.
verses.modern: Then Reuben said to his father, 'Kill my two sons if I do not bring him back to you. Put him in my hands. I will bring him back to you.'

verses.kjv: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.modern: But he said, 'My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead. He is the only one left. If harm should happen to him on the journey that you are to make, you would bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.'

chapters.summary: Jacob sent ten of his sons to buy grain in Egypt, but kept Benjamin home; Joseph recognized his brothers but concealed his identity, accused them of being spies, and imprisoned them for three days. He kept Simeon as a hostage and sent the others back to Canaan with grain and their money secretly returned in their sacks, demanding they bring Benjamin on their next trip.

verses.kjv: And the famine was sore in the land.
verses.modern: Now the famine was severe in the land.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.
verses.modern: When they had eaten the grain that they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, 'Go again, buy us a little food.'

verses.kjv: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.modern: But Judah said to him, 'The man solemnly warned us, saying, you shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.

verses.kjv: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
verses.modern: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food.

verses.kjv: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.
verses.modern: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, for the man said to us, you shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.'

verses.kjv: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?
verses.modern: Israel said, 'Why did you treat me so badly by telling the man that you had another brother?'

verses.kjv: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?
verses.modern: They replied, 'The man questioned us carefully about ourselves and our family, saying, Is your father still alive? Do you have another brother? What we told him was in answer to these questions. Could we in any way know that he would say, Bring your brother down?'

verses.kjv: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.
verses.modern: Judah said to Israel his father, 'Send the boy with me. We will arise and go, that we may live and not die, both we and you and also our little ones.

verses.kjv: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:
verses.modern: I will be a pledge of his safety. From my hand you shall require him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever.

verses.kjv: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
verses.modern: If we had not delayed, we would now have returned twice.'

verses.kjv: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:
verses.modern: Then their father Israel said to them, 'If it must be so, then do this: take some of the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry a present down to the man, a little balm and a little honey, gum, myrrh, pistachio nuts, and almonds.

verses.kjv: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:
verses.modern: Take double the money with you. Carry back with you the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.

verses.kjv: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:
verses.modern: Take also your brother, and arise, go again to the man.

verses.kjv: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.
verses.modern: May God Almighty grant you mercy before the man, and may he send back your other brother and Benjamin. And as for me, if I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.'

verses.kjv: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.modern: So the men took this present. They took double the money with them, and Benjamin. They arose and went down to Egypt and stood before Joseph.

verses.kjv: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.
verses.modern: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, 'Bring the men into the house, and slaughter an animal and make ready, for the men are to dine with me at noon.'

verses.kjv: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.
verses.modern: The man did as Joseph told him and brought the men to Joseph's house.

verses.kjv: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.
verses.modern: The men were afraid because they were brought to Joseph's house. They said, 'It is because of the money, which was replaced in our sacks the first time, that we are brought in, so that he may assault us and fall upon us to make us servants and seize our donkeys.'

verses.kjv: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,
verses.modern: So they went up to the steward of Joseph's house and spoke with him at the door of the house,

verses.kjv: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:
verses.modern: They said, 'Oh, my lord, we came down the first time to buy food.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.
verses.modern: when we came to the lodging place we opened our sacks, and there was each man's money in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. So we have brought it again with us,

verses.kjv: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.
verses.modern: we have brought other money down with us to buy food. We do not know who put our money in our sacks.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.
verses.modern: He replied, 'Peace to you, do not be afraid. Your God and the God of your father has put treasure in your sacks for you. I received your money.' Then He brought Simeon out to them.

verses.kjv: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.
verses.modern: When the man had brought the men into Joseph's house and given them water, They had washed their feet, and when he had given their donkeys fodder,

verses.kjv: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.
verses.modern: they prepared the present for Joseph's coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.

verses.kjv: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.
verses.modern: When Joseph came home, they brought into the house to him the present that they had with them and bowed down to him to the ground.

verses.kjv: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?
verses.modern: he inquired about their welfare and said, 'Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he still alive?'

verses.kjv: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.
verses.modern: They said, 'Your servant our father is well; he is still alive.' And they bowed their heads and prostrated themselves.

verses.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.
verses.modern: he lifted up his eyes and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, 'Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me? God be gracious to you, my son!'

verses.kjv: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.
verses.modern: Then Joseph hurried out, for his compassion grew warm for his brother. He sought a place to weep. And he entered his chamber and wept there.

verses.kjv: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.
verses.modern: Then he washed his face and came out. And controlling himself he said, 'Serve the food.'

verses.kjv: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.modern: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians could not eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

verses.kjv: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.
verses.modern: they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright and the youngest according to his youth. And the men looked at one another in amazement.

verses.kjv: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
verses.modern: Portions were taken to them from Joseph's table, but Benjamin's portion was five times as much as any of theirs. And they drank and were merry with him.

chapters.summary: When the grain ran out, Judah persuaded Jacob to let Benjamin go to Egypt with them, pledging his own life as surety. Joseph saw Benjamin, had them brought to his house, released Simeon, and hosted a feast where Benjamin received five times the portion of the others.

verses.kjv: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.
verses.modern: Then he commanded the steward of his house, 'Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man's money in the mouth of his sack,

verses.kjv: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
verses.modern: put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the sack of the youngest, with his money for the grain.' And he did as Joseph told him.

verses.kjv: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.
verses.modern: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away with their donkeys.

verses.kjv: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?
verses.modern: They had gone only a short distance from the city. Now Joseph said to his steward, 'Up, follow after the men, and when you overtake them, say to them, Why have you repaid evil for good?

verses.kjv: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.
verses.modern: Is it not from this that my lord drinks, and by this that he practices divination? You have done evil in doing this.'

verses.kjv: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.
verses.modern: When he overtook them, he spoke to them these words.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:
verses.modern: They said to him, 'Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants to do such a thing!

verses.kjv: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?
verses.modern: the money that we found in the mouths of our sacks we brought back to you from the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold from your lord's house?

verses.kjv: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.
verses.modern: Whichever of your servants is found with it shall die. We also will be my lord's servants.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.
verses.modern: He said, 'Let it be as you say: he who is found with it shall be my servant, and the rest of you shall be innocent.'

verses.kjv: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
verses.modern: Then each man quickly lowered his sack to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

verses.kjv: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.
verses.modern: He searched, beginning with the eldest and ending with the youngest. And the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

verses.kjv: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.
verses.modern: Then they tore their clothes, and every man loaded his donkey. They returned to the city.

verses.kjv: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
verses.modern: When Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house, he was still there. They fell before him to the ground.

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?
verses.modern: Joseph said to them, 'What deed is this that you have done? Do you not know that a man like me can indeed practice divination?'

verses.kjv: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.
verses.modern: Judah said, 'What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? Or how can we clear ourselves? God has found out the guilt of your servants; we are my lord's servants, both we and He also in whose hand the cup has been found.'

verses.kjv: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.
verses.modern: But he said, 'Far be it from me that I should do so! Only the man in whose hand the cup was found shall be my servant. But as for you, go up in peace to your father.'

verses.kjv: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.
verses.modern: Then Judah went up to him and said, 'Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not your anger burn against your servant, for you are like Pharaoh himself.

verses.kjv: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?
verses.modern: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have you a father, or a brother?

verses.kjv: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.
verses.modern: we said to my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a young brother, the child of his old age. His brother is dead. He alone is left of his mother's children. His father loves him.

verses.kjv: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.
verses.modern: Then you said to your servants, Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.

verses.kjv: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.
verses.modern: We said to my lord, The boy cannot leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

verses.kjv: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.
verses.modern: Then you said to your servants, Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall not see my face again.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.modern: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

verses.kjv: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.
verses.modern: when our father said, Go again, buy us a little food,

verses.kjv: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.
verses.modern: we said, We cannot go down. If our youngest brother goes with us, then we will go down. For we cannot see the man's face unless our youngest brother is with us.

verses.kjv: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:
verses.modern: Then your servant my father said to us, You know that my wife bore me two sons.

verses.kjv: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:
verses.modern: One left me. I said, Surely he has been torn to pieces. I have never seen him since.

verses.kjv: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
verses.modern: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs in sorrow to the grave.

verses.kjv: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;
verses.modern: Now therefore, as soon as I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us, then, as his life is bound up in the boy's life,

verses.kjv: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
verses.modern: as soon as he sees that the boy is not with us, he will die, and your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

verses.kjv: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.
verses.modern: For your servant became a pledge of safety for the boy to my father, saying, If I do not bring him back to you, then I shall bear the blame before my father all my life.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.
verses.modern: Now therefore, please let your servant remain instead of the boy as a servant to my lord, and let the boy go back with his brothers.

verses.kjv: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.
verses.modern: For how can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? I fear to see the evil that would find my father.'

chapters.summary: Joseph planted his silver cup in Benjamin's sack and sent his steward to overtake the brothers; when the cup was found, all the brothers returned to Joseph's house in dismay. Judah delivered an impassioned plea, recounting Jacob's love for Benjamin and offering himself as a slave in Benjamin's place so the boy could return to their father.

verses.kjv: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.
verses.modern: Then Joseph could not control himself before all those who stood by him. He cried, 'Make everyone go out from me.' So no one stayed with him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

verses.kjv: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.
verses.modern: He wept aloud, so that the Egyptians heard it, and the household of Pharaoh heard it.

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.
verses.modern: Joseph said to his brothers, 'I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?' But his brothers could not answer him, for they were dismayed at his presence.

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.
verses.modern: So Joseph said to his brothers, 'Come near to me, please.' And they came near. And he said, 'I am your brother, Joseph, whom you sold into Egypt.

verses.kjv: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.
verses.modern: Now do not be distressed or angry with yourselves because you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

verses.kjv: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.
verses.modern: For the famine has been in the land these two years, and there are yet five years in which there will be neither plowing nor harvest.

verses.kjv: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verses.modern: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant on earth, and to keep alive for you many survivors.

verses.kjv: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.modern: So it was not you who sent me here, but God. He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:
verses.modern: Hurry and go up to my father and say to him, Thus says your son Joseph, God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; do not wait.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:
verses.modern: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near me, you and your children and your children's children, and your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

verses.kjv: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.
verses.modern: There I will provide for you, for there are yet five years of famine to come, so that you and your household and all that you have do not come to poverty.

verses.kjv: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.
verses.modern: now your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

verses.kjv: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.
verses.modern: You must tell my father of all my honor in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. Hurry and bring my father down here.'

verses.kjv: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.modern: Then he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck and wept, and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

verses.kjv: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.
verses.modern: he kissed all his brothers and wept upon them. After that his brothers talked with him.

verses.kjv: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
verses.modern: When the report was heard in Pharaoh's house, 'Joseph's brothers have come,' it pleased Pharaoh and his servants.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
verses.modern: Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'Say to your brothers, Do this: load your beasts and go back to the land of Canaan,

verses.kjv: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.
verses.modern: take your father and your households, and come to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.

verses.kjv: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.modern: you, Joseph, are commanded to say, Do this: take wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

verses.kjv: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is your's.
verses.modern: Have no concern for your goods, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.'

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
verses.modern: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the command of Pharaoh, and gave them provisions for the journey.

verses.kjv: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.
verses.modern: To each of them he gave a change of clothes, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five changes of clothes.

verses.kjv: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
verses.modern: To his father he sent as follows: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and provision for his father on the journey.

verses.kjv: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.
verses.modern: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they departed, he said to them, 'Do not quarrel on the way.'

verses.kjv: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,
verses.modern: So they went up out of Egypt and came to the land of Canaan to their father Jacob.

verses.kjv: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.
verses.modern: they told him, 'Joseph is still alive. He is ruler over all the land of Egypt.' And his heart became numb, for he did not believe them.

verses.kjv: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
verses.modern: But when they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.

verses.kjv: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
verses.modern: Israel said, 'It is enough; Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.'

chapters.summary: Joseph could no longer restrain himself and revealed his identity to his brothers, weeping aloud, telling them not to be angry with themselves because God had sent him ahead to preserve life during the famine. Pharaoh invited the whole family to settle in the best of Egypt's land, and the brothers returned to Canaan with wagons and gifts to bring Jacob down to Egypt.

verses.kjv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.
verses.modern: So Israel took his journey with all that he had and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of His father Isaac.

verses.kjv: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
verses.modern: God spoke to Israel in visions of the night and said, 'Jacob, Jacob.' And he said, 'Here I am.'

verses.kjv: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:
verses.modern: Then he said, 'I am God, the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for there I will make you into a great nation.

verses.kjv: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.
verses.modern: I myself will go down with you to Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. And Joseph's hand shall close your eyes.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob rose up from Beersheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.modern: Then Jacob set out from Beersheba. The sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, their little ones and their wives, in the wagons that Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

verses.kjv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:
verses.modern: They also took their livestock and their goods, which they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob and all his seed with him,

verses.kjv: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.
verses.modern: his sons and his sons' sons with him, his daughters and his sons' daughters, and all his seed he brought with him into Egypt.

verses.kjv: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.
verses.modern: Now these are the names of the descendants of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons. Reuben, Jacob's firstborn,

verses.kjv: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.modern: the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Phallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
verses.modern: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.modern: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.modern: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Pharez, and Zarah (but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan). And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
verses.modern: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Phuvah, Job, and Shimron.
