verses.kjv: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.modern: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

verses.kjv: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padanaram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padanaram, together with his daughter Dinah; altogether his sons and his daughters numbered thirty-three.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.
verses.modern: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.
verses.modern: The sons of Asher: Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui, Beriah, with Serah their sister. And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter. These she bore to Jacob — sixteen persons.

verses.kjv: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.
verses.modern: The sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.kjv: And unTo Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
verses.modern: to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potipherah the priest of On, bore to him.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.
verses.modern: the sons of Benjamin: Belah, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob — fourteen persons in all.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
verses.modern: The son of Dan: Hushim.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.modern: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.
verses.modern: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter. These she bore to Jacob — seven persons in all.

verses.kjv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;
verses.modern: All the persons belonging to Jacob who came into Egypt, who were his direct descendants, not counting Jacob's sons' wives, were sixty-six persons in all.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
verses.modern: the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two. All the persons of the house of Jacob who came into Egypt were seventy.

verses.kjv: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.modern: Israel sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph, to show the way before him in Goshen. And they came into the land of Goshen.

verses.kjv: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.modern: Then Joseph prepared his chariot and went up to meet Israel his father in Goshen. He presented himself to him and fell on his neck and wept on his neck a good while.

verses.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
verses.modern: Israel said to Joseph, 'Now let me die, since I have seen your face and know that you are still alive.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;
verses.modern: Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's household, 'I will go up and tell Pharaoh and will say to him, My brothers and my father's household, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

verses.kjv: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.
verses.modern: the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock. They have brought their flocks and their herds and all that they have.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
verses.modern: When Pharaoh calls you and says, What is your occupation?

verses.kjv: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.modern: you shall say, Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we and our fathers, in order that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.'

chapters.summary: The descendants of Israel who went down to Egypt are listed, seventy persons in all, organized by the sons of Leah, Zilpah, Rachel, and Bilhah. God spoke to Jacob at Beersheba, promising to make him a great nation in Egypt, and Joseph met his father in Goshen where they wept together.

verses.kjv: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
verses.modern: So Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, 'My father and my brothers, with their flocks and herds and all that they possess, have come from the land of Canaan. They are now in the land of Goshen.'

verses.kjv: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
verses.modern: From among his brothers he took five men and presented them to Pharaoh.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
verses.modern: Pharaoh said to his brothers, 'What is your occupation?' And they said to Pharaoh, 'Your servants are shepherds, as our fathers were.'

verses.kjv: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
verses.modern: They said to Pharaoh, 'We have come to stay in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants' flocks, for the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. And now, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.'

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:
verses.modern: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'Your father and your brothers have come to you.

verses.kjv: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
verses.modern: The land of Egypt is before you. Settle your father and your brothers in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen, and if you know any able men among them, put them in charge of my livestock.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.modern: Then Joseph brought in Jacob his father and set him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?
verses.modern: Pharaoh said to Jacob, 'How many are the days of the years of your life?'

verses.kjv: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verses.modern: Jacob said to Pharaoh, 'The days of the years of my sojourning are 130 years. Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their sojourning.'

verses.kjv: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
verses.modern: Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

verses.kjv: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.modern: Then Joseph settled his father and his brothers and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

verses.kjv: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.
verses.modern: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all his father's household with food, according to the number of their dependents.

verses.kjv: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
verses.modern: Now there was no food in all the land, for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan languished by reason of the famine.

verses.kjv: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.
verses.modern: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, in exchange for the grain that they bought. And Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

verses.kjv: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.
verses.modern: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, 'Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? For our money is gone.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
verses.modern: Joseph answered, 'Give your livestock. I will give you food in exchange for your livestock, if your money is gone.'

verses.kjv: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
verses.modern: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them food in exchange for the horses, the flocks, the herds, and the donkeys. He supplied them with food in exchange for all their livestock that year.

verses.kjv: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
verses.modern: When that year was ended, they came to him the following year and said to him, 'We will not hide from my lord that our money is all spent. The herds of livestock are my lord's. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord but our bodies and our land.

verses.kjv: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
verses.modern: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for food. We with our land will be servants to Pharaoh. And give us seed that we may live and not die, and that the land may not be desolate.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.
verses.modern: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for all the Egyptians sold their fields, because the famine was severe on them. The land became Pharaoh's.

verses.kjv: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
verses.modern: As for the people, he moved them into the cities from one end of the border of Egypt to the other.

verses.kjv: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
verses.modern: Only the land of the priests he did not buy, for the priests had a fixed allowance from Pharaoh and lived on the allowance that Pharaoh gave them; therefore they did not sell their land.

verses.kjv: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
verses.modern: Then Joseph said to the people, ' I have this day bought you and your land for Pharaoh. Now here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
verses.modern: at the harvests you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four fifths shall be your own, as seed for the field and as food for yourselves and your households, and as food for your little ones.'

verses.kjv: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
verses.modern: they said, 'You have saved our lives; may it please my lord, we will be servants to Pharaoh.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.
verses.modern: So Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt. It stands to this day, that Pharaoh should have a fifth; the land of the priests alone did not become Pharaoh's.

verses.kjv: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.modern: Thus Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen. And they gained possessions in it, and were fruitful and multiplied greatly.

verses.kjv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
verses.modern: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were 147 years.

verses.kjv: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:
verses.modern: when the time drew near that Israel must die, he called his son Joseph and said to him, 'If now I have found favor in your sight, put your hand under my thigh and deal kindly and truly with me. Do not bury me in Egypt,

verses.kjv: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.
verses.modern: but let me lie with my fathers. Carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burying place.' He answered, 'I will do as you have said.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.
verses.modern: He said, 'Swear to me.' And he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself upon the head of his bed.

chapters.summary: Joseph presented his family to Pharaoh, who granted them the land of Goshen; Jacob blessed Pharaoh and told him he was 130 years old. As the famine continued, Joseph collected all the money, livestock, and land of Egypt for Pharaoh, establishing a law that one-fifth of all produce belonged to the crown. Jacob lived seventeen years in Egypt and made Joseph swear to bury him in Canaan with his fathers.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.modern: After this, Joseph was told, ' your father is ill.' So he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
verses.modern: It was told to Jacob, 'Your son Joseph has come to you.' Then Israel summoned his strength and sat up in bed.

verses.kjv: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
verses.modern: Jacob said to Joseph, 'God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me,

verses.kjv: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.
verses.modern: said to me, I will make you fruitful and multiply you, and will make of you a company of peoples and will give this land to your seed after you for an everlasting possession.

verses.kjv: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
verses.modern: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you in Egypt, are mine. Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, as Reuben and Simeon are.

verses.kjv: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
verses.modern: The children that you father after them shall be yours. They shall be called by the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

verses.kjv: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.
verses.modern: As for me, when I came from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to go to Ephrath. I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).'

verses.kjv: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?
verses.modern: When Israel saw Joseph's sons, he said, 'Who are these?'

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.
verses.modern: Joseph said to his father, 'They are my sons, whom God has given me here.' And He said, 'Bring them to me, please, that I may bless them.'

verses.kjv: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
verses.modern: Now the eyes of Israel were dim with age, so that he could not see. So Joseph brought them near him. He kissed them and embraced them.

verses.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.
verses.modern: Israel said to Joseph, 'I never expected to see your face. God has let me see your seed also.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.modern: Then Joseph removed them from his knees and bowed himself with his face to the earth.

verses.kjv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.
verses.modern: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near him.

verses.kjv: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
verses.modern: Israel stretched out his right hand and laid it on the head of Ephraim, who was the younger, and his left hand on the head of Manasseh, crossing his hands intentionally, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

verses.kjv: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
verses.modern: He blessed Joseph and said, 'The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God Who has been my shepherd all my life long to this day,

verses.kjv: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
verses.modern: the Angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the boys. In them let my name be carried on, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a crowd in the midst of the earth.'

verses.kjv: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.
verses.modern: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He took his father's hand to move it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.
verses.modern: Joseph said to his father, 'Not this way, my father; since this one is the firstborn, put your right hand on his head.'

verses.kjv: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
verses.modern: But his father refused and said, 'I know, my son, I know. He also shall become a people. He also shall be great. Nevertheless, his younger brother shall be greater than he. His seed shall become a crowd of nations.'

verses.kjv: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.modern: So he blessed them that day, saying, 'By you Israel will pronounce blessings, saying, God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh.' Thus he put Ephraim before Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
verses.modern: Then Israel said to Joseph, ' I am about to die. But God will be with you and will bring you again to the land of your fathers.

verses.kjv: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
verses.modern: Moreover, I have given to you rather than to your brothers one mountain slope that I took from the hand of the Amorites with my sword and with my bow.'

chapters.summary: Jacob adopted Joseph's two sons Ephraim and Manasseh as his own, giving them equal standing with Reuben and Simeon among the tribes of Israel. When blessing them, Jacob deliberately crossed his hands and placed his right hand on the younger Ephraim's head, declaring that Ephraim would be greater than his older brother Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
verses.modern: Then Jacob called his sons and said, 'Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in days to come.

verses.kjv: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
verses.modern: Assemble and listen, O sons of Jacob, listen to Israel your father.

verses.kjv: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
verses.modern: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the firstfruits of my strength, preeminent in dignity and preeminent in power.

verses.kjv: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
verses.modern: Unstable as water, you shall not have preeminence, because you went up to your father's bed; then you defiled it—he went up to my couch!

verses.kjv: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
verses.modern: Simeon and Levi are brothers; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

verses.kjv: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
verses.modern: Let my soul come not into their council; O my glory, be not joined to their company. For in their anger they killed men, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

verses.kjv: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
verses.modern: Cursed be their anger, for it is fierce. Their wrath, for it is cruel! I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.

verses.kjv: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
verses.modern: Judah, your brothers shall praise you; your hand shall be on the neck of your enemies; your father's sons shall bow down before you.

verses.kjv: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verses.modern: Judah is a lion's cub; from the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched like a lion and like a lioness; who dares rouse him?

verses.kjv: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
verses.modern: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between His feet, until Shiloh come; and unto Him shall the gathering of the people be.

verses.kjv: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
verses.modern: Binding His foal to the vine and his donkey's colt to the choice vine, He has washed His garments in wine and His robes in the blood of grapes.

verses.kjv: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
verses.modern: His eyes shall be red with wine, and His teeth white with milk.

verses.kjv: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
verses.modern: Zebulun shall dwell at the shore of the sea; He shall become a haven for ships. His border shall be at Zidon.

verses.kjv: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
verses.modern: Issachar is a strong donkey, crouching between two burdens.

verses.kjv: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
verses.modern: He saw that a resting place was good, and that the land was pleasant, so He bowed His shoulder to bear, and became a servant at forced labor.

verses.kjv: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.modern: Dan shall judge His people as one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
verses.modern: Dan shall be a serpent in the way, a viper by the path, that bites the horse's heels so that His rider falls backward.

verses.kjv: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
verses.modern: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD.

verses.kjv: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
verses.modern: Raiders shall raid Gad, but He shall overcome at the last.

verses.kjv: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.modern: Asher's food shall be rich. He shall yield royal delicacies.

verses.kjv: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
verses.modern: Naphtali is a hind let loose that giveth goodly words.

verses.kjv: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
verses.modern: Joseph is a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a spring; his branches run over the wall.

verses.kjv: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
verses.modern: The archers bitterly attacked him, shot at him, and harassed him severely,

verses.kjv: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
verses.modern: yet his bow remained unmoved. His arms were made strong by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob (from there is the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel),

verses.kjv: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
verses.modern: by the God of Your father who will help You, by the Almighty Who will bless You with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that crouches beneath, blessings of the breasts and of the womb.

verses.kjv: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
verses.modern: The blessings of your father are mighty beyond the blessings of my ancestors, up to the bounties of the everlasting hills. May they be on the head of Joseph, and on the brow of him who was set apart from his brothers.

verses.kjv: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
verses.modern: Benjamin is a ravenous wolf, in the morning devouring the prey and at evening dividing the spoil.'

verses.kjv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
verses.modern: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel. This is what their father said to them as he blessed them; he blessed each with the blessing suitable to him.

verses.kjv: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.modern: Then he commanded them and said to them, 'I am to be gathered to my people; bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

verses.kjv: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
verses.modern: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, to the east of Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite to possess as a burying place.

verses.kjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
verses.modern: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried; there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried. There I buried Leah—

verses.kjv: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
verses.modern: the field and the cave that is in it were bought from the sons of Heth.'

verses.kjv: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.modern: When Jacob finished commanding his sons, he drew up his feet into the bed and breathed his last and was gathered to his people.

chapters.summary: Jacob gathered his twelve sons and pronounced a prophetic blessing on each, rebuking Reuben for his instability, cursing the anger of Simeon and Levi, and exalting Judah with the promise that the scepter would not depart from him until Shiloh come. After blessing the remaining sons — including Joseph with abundant fruitfulness and Benjamin as a ravenous wolf — Jacob commanded them to bury him in the cave of Machpelah, then drew up his feet into the bed and died.

verses.kjv: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
verses.modern: Then Joseph fell on his father's face and wept over him and kissed him.

verses.kjv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.modern: Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. So the physicians embalmed Israel.

verses.kjv: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
verses.modern: Forty days were required for it, for that is how many are required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

verses.kjv: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.modern: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to the household of Pharaoh, saying, 'If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

verses.kjv: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
verses.modern: My father made me swear, saying, I am about to die. In the tomb that I hewed out for myself in the land of Canaan, there you shall bury me. Now therefore, let me please go up and bury my father. Then I will return.'

verses.kjv: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
verses.modern: Pharaoh answered, 'Go up, and bury your father, as he made you swear.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.modern: So Joseph went up to bury his father. With him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his household, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

verses.kjv: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.modern: as well as all the household of Joseph, his brothers, and his father's household. Only their children, their flocks, and their herds were left in the land of Goshen.

verses.kjv: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
verses.modern: There went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.

verses.kjv: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
verses.modern: When they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, they lamented there with a very great and grievous lamentation. He made a mourning for his father seven days.

verses.kjv: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
verses.modern: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning on the threshing floor of Atad, they said, 'This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.' Therefore the place was named Abel-mizraim; it is beyond the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
verses.modern: Thus his sons did for him as he had commanded them,

verses.kjv: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
verses.modern: For his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave of the field at Machpelah, to the east of Mamre, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite to possess as a burying place.

verses.kjv: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
verses.modern: After he had buried his father, Joseph returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had gone up with him to bury his father.

verses.kjv: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
verses.modern: When Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, 'It may be that Joseph will hate us and pay us back for all the evil that we did to him.'

verses.kjv: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
verses.modern: So they sent a message to Joseph, saying, 'Your father gave this command before he died,

verses.kjv: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
verses.modern: Say to Joseph, Please forgive the transgression of your brothers and their sin, because they did evil to you. And now, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father.' Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

verses.kjv: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
verses.modern: His brothers also came and fell down before him and said, ' we are your servants.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
verses.modern: But Joseph said to them, 'Do not fear, for am I in the place of God?

verses.kjv: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
verses.modern: As for you, you meant evil against me. But God meant it for good, to bring it about that many people should be kept alive, as they are today.

verses.kjv: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
verses.modern: So do not fear; I will provide for you and your little ones.' Thus he comforted them and spoke kindly to them.

verses.kjv: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
verses.modern: So Joseph remained in Egypt, he and his father's house. Joseph lived 110 years.

verses.kjv: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.
verses.modern: Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation. The children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up on Joseph's knees.

verses.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.modern: Joseph said to his brothers, 'I am about to die. But God will surely visit you and bring you up out of this land to the land that He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.'

verses.kjv: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
verses.modern: Then Joseph made the sons of Israel swear, saying, 'God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.'

verses.kjv: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and the days of Joseph were fulfilled: and they were embalmed in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.modern: So Joseph died, being 110 years old. They embalmed him. He was put in a coffin in Egypt.

chapters.summary: Joseph had his father embalmed, and a great company of Egyptians and Israelites carried Jacob's body to Canaan and buried him in the cave of Machpelah. After returning to Egypt, Joseph's brothers feared he would take revenge, but Joseph told them not to fear, declaring that what they meant for evil God meant for good to save many lives. Joseph lived 110 years, saw his great-grandchildren, and before dying made Israel swear to carry his bones out of Egypt when God visited them.
